Network Solutions Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Network Solutions Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Cloud Networking Engineer to design, deploy, and operate cloud networking infrastructure across one or more major cloud providers. The role covers VPC/VNet design, hybrid connectivity, transit topologies, edge networking, DNS, and the security controls that make cloud networking reliable and safe at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep traditional networking knowledge with cloud-native networking patterns, has built production cloud networks at meaningful scale, and brings strong automation discipline to networking work. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate cloud networking architectures including VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, and security groups.
  • Build transit hub topologies using AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN, or GCP Network Connectivity Center.
  • Design and implement hybrid connectivity using Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect, and VPN.
  • Architect edge networking including CDN, global load balancing, and WAF integration.
  • Implement DNS strategies including Route 53, Azure DNS, or Cloud DNS with hybrid resolution.
  • Design private connectivity to managed services using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, or Private Service Connect.
  • Automate cloud networking with Terraform, providing infrastructure-as-code coverage across the network estate.
  • Implement network security controls including firewalls, NACLs, security groups, and DDoS protection.
  • Operate Kubernetes networking including CNI selection, ingress strategies, and service exposure patterns.
  • Build observability for cloud networking including flow logs, traffic insights, and packet capture.
  • Drive cost optimization including data transfer reduction and right-sizing of network resources.
  • Partner with security teams to harden the network perimeter and enforce zero-trust principles.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud networking issues across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Stay current with cloud networking platform updates and emerging patterns.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in networking, with significant time on cloud networking.
  • Deep hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, BGP, and modern networking fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or equivalents).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code for cloud networking, especially Terraform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security and network controls.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and service mesh fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting and packet-level analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Cloud networking specialty certifications (AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer).
  • Experience with multi-cloud networking and cloud-to-cloud connectivity.
  • Familiarity with SD-WAN platforms and SASE architectures.
  • Experience with eBPF-based networking tools.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict network segmentation requirements.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to  or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Als globaler Marktführer in der anatomischen und digitalen Pathologie und Teil von Danaher, einem der weltweit führenden Life-Science-Konzerne, verbindet Leica Biosystems wissenschaftliche Exzellenz, technologische Innovationskraft und unternehmerisches Wachstum. Unser Portfolio reicht von klassischer Histologie bis hin zu digitalen und KI-gestützten Diagnostiklösungen, die den Workflow von der Biopsie bis zur Diagnose abdecken.

Diese Position richtet sich an Persönlichkeiten, die Vertrieb strategisch denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltige Wertschöpfung gestalten wollen.

Warum Leica Biosystems?

Ihr Profil

raw.description:
IsoMetrix is a leading provider of integrated risk management software solutions. Our product suite helps organizations effectively manage governance, risk, and compliance across their operations.

Role Overview

As a Senior Backend Engineer at IsoMetrix, you will play a leading role in the design and development of our next-generation, cloud-native SaaS platform. Working within the Product and Engineering team, you will build and maintain the backend services, APIs and data architecture that power our multi-tenant, multi-lingual Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) solutions used by customers around the world.

This is a hands-on engineering role on a modern .NET stack, with the opportunity to shape architecture, uphold engineering standards and mentor other members of the team. You will work on greenfield development using technologies such as .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, Azure and applying best practices to create secure and maintainable software.

Key Responsibilities

Software Design & Development

  • Design, build and maintain backend services, APIs and libraries for IsoMetrix's cloud native SaaS platform.
  • Write clean, well-structured and testable code.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and help evolve a scalable, secure, multi-tenant platform.
  • Develop reusable components and libraries to accelerate future development.

APIs & Integration

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and services consumed by web and mobile clients.
  • Build event-driven and asynchronous components using message queues (e.g. Azure Service Bus).
  • Ensure performance, scalability and cross-platform compatibility across services.

Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Ensure software quality through unit, integration and automated testing.
  • Participate in code reviews and uphold engineering best practices and coding standards.
  • Build secure solutions with data protection and multi-tenancy in mind.
  • Support continuous improvement, refactoring and performance optimisation of existing services.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work within an Agile team alongside engineers, QA, product managers and designers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate functional and technical requirements into working software.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, sharing knowledge and helping raise the bar across the team.

Experience

Required Experience

  • Significant commercial experience as a backend software engineer, including time in a senior or lead capacity.
  • Proven track record designing, building and shipping production software on the .NET stack.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience working with relational databases and writing efficient SQL.
  • Experience building and deploying cloud-based applications, ideally on Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience working with AI both as a product offering and as a part of their workflow

Technical Skills

  • C# and ASP.NET Core (.NET 10 / .NET Core).
  • Entity Framework Core.
  • RESTful API design and development.
  • SQL and relational database design (e.g. Azure SQL / SQL Server).
  • Architectural patterns and principles such as Vertical Slice Architecture.
  • Cloud services and tooling, ideally the Microsoft Azure platform (Azure Web Apps, Azure SQL).
  • Source control with Git and GitHub.
  • Containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

Soft Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Able to work well with ambiguity
  • Good time-management skills and the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.
  • A collaborative team player who is willing to mentor and share knowledge.
  • A positive, proactive attitude and the ability to stay calm under pressure.
  • A continuous-learning mindset with a genuine interest in new technologies.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with message queues (e.g. Azure Service Bus).
  • Experience building multi-tenant, multi-lingual SaaS applications.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript and Vue.js.
  • Exposure to the EHS, ESG or Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) domain.
  • .NET Aspire (cloud-native orchestration)
  • Observability (OpenTelemetry)
  • Identity & access (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect)
  • Resilience patterns (retries, timeouts, circuit breakers)
  • Distributed caching (Redis)

That’s why we’re on the hunt for the Community Growth & Sales Specialist who’s ready to make a real impact.

❕This role is 100% remote and you will join a team that already works from 20 different world countries.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a strategic, analytical, and entrepreneurial mind to turn online communities—especially Facebook groups—into revenue-generating powerhouses. You’ll drive engagement, build relationships, and convert active audiences into customers.

If you love solving complex puzzles, spotting untapped opportunities, and figuring things out independently, this might be your dream job.

This isn’t a role for someone who waits for instructions. We need a problem solver who thrives on challenges, loves puzzles, and finds creative ways to drive sales without relying on traditional marketing channels.

You’ll have access to a high-level, premium training program to master community-based sales strategies, but ultimately, we expect you to take ownership, experiment, and make things happen.

  • Identify, infiltrate, and engage with high-potential community groups (mainly on Facebook) to drive sales.

  • Craft compelling, high-converting posts and discussions that don’t feel like sales pitches.

  • Create visuals and copy that grab attention and build trust.

  • Solve problems on the spot—whether it’s engagement drops, algorithm shifts, or content flops.

  • Run experiments and track data to constantly optimize your approach.

  • Own the entire sales pipeline from community interactions to conversions—no micromanagement, just results.

Requirements

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Analytical & Strategic – You see patterns, connect the dots, and solve complex problems like a pro.

  • Entrepreneurial & Self-Sufficient – You don’t ask for solutions; you find them.

  • Geeky & Tech-Savvy – You love testing new tools, staying ahead of trends, and understanding platforms inside out.

  • Creative & Persuasive – You know how to craft content that sells without being "salesy."

  • Data-Driven & Adaptive – You test, tweak, and iterate to optimize performance.

IDEAL BACKGROUND

  • Experience in e-commerce, tech, or digital marketing.

  • Strong copywriting & content creation skills.

  • Ability to design simple yet effective visuals for posts.

  • Track record of driving sales through online communities (especially Facebook).

  • Deep understanding of social media algorithms and engagement tactics.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • 10 min online DISC assessment to identify your behavioral style, as we strongly believe in the power of diverse teams.

  • 15-30 min intro e-meet with Foxelli Group Talent Acquisition team to discuss company, role, your experiences, and expectations.

  • Home Task.

  • 60 min e-meet with the Hiring Manager and Foxelli Group CPO to discuss the vision of the role, your competencies, and technical skills, followed by a two-way Q&A session.

  • Decision & Feedback from us.

SALARY

€1100 - €2000 after taxes (depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience) with the potential for quarterly performance-based bonuses tied to KPIs.

❕Please note that this role requires a self-employment certificate.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and keeping your physical well-being in check.

  • A personal development budget is at your disposal for yourpersonal and professional growth to ensure you keep continuously growing.

  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.

  • A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.

  • Strong company cultureand a network of unique individuals that celebrates you.

  • Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting for your control of a working day, powered by Hubstaff for transparency and fairness.

ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is UTC+2 and UTC+3. We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

Who we are:

Quavo is the industry leader in fraud and disputes management technology, offering the world’s only E2E cloud-based Disputes as a Service solution for issuing financial services organizations. Quavo is an organization of tenacious experts who are innovative and challenge complacency to continuously deliver cutting edge technology and AI. Our experts are passionate about delivering value in our solutions and empowering our client community to enhance and evolve industry standards in fraud and disputes management.

About the role:

The Technical Support Analyst is a Tier 2 role within Quavo's Client Support team, responsible for resolving the technical issues that fall outside the scope of Tier 1 Client Advocates and do not require Engineering involvement. This includes configuration, integration, environment, and data-related issues escalated from Tier 1 or routed by AI triage. The Technical Support Analyst investigates, diagnoses, and resolves these issues directly,engagingEngineering (Tier 3) only for true code-level defects orissues.

Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the Tier 2 escalation point for technical issues routed from Tier 1 Client Advocates and AI agents, including configuration, integration, environment, and data-related issues.
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve client-reported technical issues, using diagnostic scripts, knowledge bases, and internal tools to drive timely resolution.
  • Accurately distinguish true code-level defects from configuration, data, or environment issues, and escalate only genuine code defects and issues to Engineering (Tier 3).
  • Partner with Engineering to provide clear, well-documented handoffs for escalated issues, including reproduction steps, logs, and diagnostic findings.
  • Manage an assigned ticket queue within Salesforce Service Cloud, ensuring tickets are updated, prioritized, and resolved according to department SLAs and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot database, API, and SQL-related issues as part of client environment and integration support.
  • Support client go-lives and upgrades by troubleshooting technical challenges during onboarding and release upgrades.
  • Identify recurring issues and trends, and recommend improvements to processes, documentation, and knowledge base content to reduce future ticket volume.
  • Provide guidance and technical mentorship to Tier 1 Client Advocates to support first-contact resolution and appropriate triage.
  • Contribute to the ongoing optimization of support tooling, including ticketing systems, automation, and AI agent capabilities.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with clients throughout the resolution process, including status updates on complex or long-running issues.
  • Provide statistical and performance data to the Director of Technical Support, including trends in ticket volume, resolution time, and escalation rates.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives such as product launches and platform migrations, coordinating with Engineering and other teams as needed.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in a technical field,with at least5years of experience ina technicalsupport, or related technical role.
  • Strong technical acumen with the ability to distinguish configuration, data, and integration issues from true code-level defects.
  • Experience with Database, APIs, and SQL troubleshooting.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a methodical approach to diagnosing issues.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume ticket queue, prioritize effectively, and meet resolution SLAs.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across Client Support and Engineering teams.
  • Working knowledge of MS Windows and MS Office (including email) as well as internet browser operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in SaaS
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud (or SFDC) and related tools
  • Experience with PEGA
  • Experience working within a tiered support model

Position:

Global Commercial Program Lead - Microsoft


Job Description:

Why You'll Love This Role:

Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next.

As the Global Commercial Program Lead, you are responsible for translating Microsoft commercial programs and business policies into clear, actionable, and operationally ready frameworks for Arrow teams, sellers, and partners.

You make sure that Microsoft program updates, policy changes, incentive structures, commercial opportunities, and business requirements are understood by the right internal audiences and converted into practical execution plans. Your role is to reduce complexity, create clarity, and help local teams activate Microsoft programs with confidence. You are the connection point between Microsoft commercial stakeholders, Arrow global teams, regional and country sales teams, operations, enablement, and partner-facing teams. Your success is measured by how effectively commercial programs are understood, adopted, and executed in the field — and how clearly partners are supported through those motions.

What You'll Do:

  • Translate Microsoft commercial programs into Arrow-ready execution by simplifying program requirements, business policies, incentives, and commercial motions into clear guidance for internal teams.

  • Drive operational readiness by ensuring that new or changing Microsoft programs are understood across sales, operations, platform, enablement, marketing, and country teams before they are launched in the field.

  • Build seller enablement frameworks that help Arrow sales teams understand what the program is, why it matters, how to position it, and how to activate it with partners.

  • Support partner success by making sure partners receive clear, practical, and consistent guidance on Microsoft commercial programs, policy changes, and growth opportunities.

  • Act as the internal expert for Microsoft commercial programs and policies by answering questions, clarifying requirements, guiding teams through changes, and escalating unresolved topics when needed.

  • Liaise with Microsoft commercial stakeholders to understand upcoming program changes, business priorities, incentive updates, policy shifts, and execution expectations.

  • Connect commercial strategy with field execution by turning Microsoft priorities into practical playbooks, communication packs, training materials, and country activation plans.

  • Support local country and regional teams by providing program guidance, readiness materials, structured follow-up, and escalation support.

  • Coordinate with operations and platform teams to ensure that commercial program requirements are reflected in operational processes, systems, tools, and partner experience.

  • Track adoption, execution, and blockers by consolidating country feedback, identifying gaps, monitoring readiness progress, and preparing clear updates for leadership.

  • Create a consistent communication rhythm for Microsoft commercial program updates, ensuring internal teams know what is changing, what action is required and where to find support.

  • Support governance and leadership communication by preparing executive-ready summaries, decision points, readiness updates, and recommendations.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Strong understanding of the Microsoft commercial ecosystem, including partner programs, incentives, policies, sales motions, and channel execution.

  • Experience translating complex vendor programs or business policies into practical field enablement, operational readiness, and partner-facing guidance.

  • Strong understanding of how a value-added distributor operates, including partner models, channel dynamics, seller enablement, operational processes, and country execution.

  • Experience working with sales, operations, enablement, vendor management, platform teams, and partner-facing organizations.

  • Proven ability to manage internal and external stakeholders across a complex, international business environment.

  • Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives, deadlines, stakeholders, and regions in parallel.

  • Ability to simplify complex commercial topics and turn them into clear communication, playbooks, FAQs, training materials, and action plans.

  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand how commercial programs translate into revenue growth, partner engagement, and field execution.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where vendor programs, business policies and priorities evolve frequently.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to create concise, structured, and executive-ready updates.

What's In It For You:

At Arrow, we're committed to helping our employees thrive, both at work and beyond. Along with competitive compensation, we offer a range of benefits that support your health, financial well-being, work-life balance, and professional growth. Your benefits may include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance

  • 401k, With Matching Contributions

  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance

  • Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options

  • Paid Time Off (including sick, holiday, vacation, etc.)

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Growth Opportunities

  • Discounted RTD Passes, with convenient office location off RTD Light Rail (Dry Creek Exit)

  • On-site Café with Catering Option for Busy Lifestyles

  • 24/7/365 On-site Gym and Lockers, Free for Use to All Employees!

  • Bike Racks

  • And more!

Work Arrangement:

Fully Remote: Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.

About Arrow

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better. At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges. Job Description Summary

Responsible for providing leadership and strategic direction for the Commercial Surety business, driving underwriting excellence, profitable growth, portfolio performance, and market competitiveness. Serves as the senior underwriting executive accountable for establishing and executing underwriting strategy, risk appetite, product direction, and distribution objectives across the business. Leads a geographically dispersed team of underwriting leaders and directs the development of talent, succession strategies, and organizational capabilities to ensure long-term business success.

Oversees portfolio management, underwriting governance, capacity deployment, and emerging risk assessment to optimize profitability, growth, and operational effectiveness. Maintains key relationships with distribution partners, reinsurance stakeholders, and industry leaders while ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, underwriting standards, and enterprise risk management practices. Acts as the principal subject matter expert and strategic advisor for the Commercial Surety business, influencing business outcomes through data-driven decision-making, market insight, and disciplined underwriting execution.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Business Leadership & Distribution Management

  • Provides executive leadership for the Commercial Surety line of business, establishing and executing long-term strategies that drive profitable growth, market expansion, and sustainable competitive advantage.

  • Leads a team of Home Office and Regional Directors, creating alignment between underwriting, distribution, and business objectives across the operating territory.

  • Develops and maintains executive-level relationships with key agencies, brokers, producers, and industry stakeholders, influencing distribution strategy and optimizing market presence.

  • Directs agency and broker appointment strategies, ensuring alignment with growth objectives, risk appetite, and profitability goals.

Underwriting Strategy, Portfolio Management & Risk Governance

  • Establishes and maintains underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, authority structures, guidelines, and governance frameworks for the Commercial Surety portfolio.

  • Serves as the senior underwriting authority and principal subject matter expert, ensuring consistent underwriting discipline and portfolio management practices across the organization.

  • Oversees portfolio performance, capacity utilization, emerging risk assessment, and underwriting results to achieve profitability and growth objectives.

  • Collaborates with internal business partners on underwriting audits, quality assurance processes, and compliance activities to ensure adherence to underwriting standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Engages with reinsurance partners and executive stakeholders to communicate portfolio performance, strategic initiatives, and risk management outcomes.

Financial Performance & Product Management

  • Accountable for achieving financial objectives for the Commercial Surety business, including premium growth, profitability, retention, and expense management targets.

  • Oversees pricing strategy, risk selection practices, and portfolio optimization efforts to maximize underwriting performance and return on capital.

  • Provides strategic direction for product development, policy form enhancement, rate adequacy initiatives, and regulatory filings.

  • Partners with enterprise leadership to evaluate market opportunities, competitive trends, and business performance, adjusting strategies as needed to achieve desired results.

Talent Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Provides leadership, coaching, and development for underwriting leaders and teams, fostering a caring, high-performance culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

  • Establishes organizational capability strategies, including workforce planning, succession management, talent retention, talent acquisition, and leadership development.

  • Maintains full management accountability for performance management, compensation decisions, employee engagement, and workforce effectiveness.

  • Develops future underwriting leaders and strengthens organizational bench strength to support long-term business objectives.

Operational Excellence & Business Transformation

  • Provides executive sponsorship and strategic direction for underwriting technology, workflow optimization, and business transformation initiatives.

  • Partners with technology, analytics, and operations leaders to enhance underwriting platforms, predictive modeling capabilities, and portfolio management tools.

  • Drives continuous improvement efforts that improve underwriting efficiency, decision quality, scalability, and customer experience while supporting enterprise objectives.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to VP – Head of Surety, leads a team of professionals.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in risk management, Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree in business administration (MBA), Finance, Risk Management, Economics, or related discipline is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of CPCU and AFSB helpful.

Experience: Minimum of 15 years of Underwriting/Marketing/Leadership experience in the surety bond marketplace. Prior-related experience will be considered but most recently in surety marketplace with key broker contacts. Significant experience leading Commercial Surety underwriting operations with responsibility for profitability, growth, and portfolio performance. Experience managing large accounts, complex surety programs, and significant underwriting authority. Experience developing and executing underwriting strategies, risk appetite frameworks, and portfolio management initiatives. Demonstrated success leading geographically dispersed underwriting teams and developing underwriting leaders. Experience working with brokers, agents, producers, and key distribution partners. Experience presenting business results and strategic initiatives to executive leadership. Experience leading a national or multi-regional Commercial Surety business. Experience managing reinsurance relationships and negotiating treaty structures. Experience overseeing product development, pricing strategies, regulatory filings, and form development. Experience leading underwriting transformation, technology implementation, predictive modeling, or analytics initiatives. Experience managing P&L or direct financial accountability for a product line or business segment.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of the surety bond marketplace, general, retail, broker and agency systems, state and local filing systems, underwriting and marketing principles and techniques. Strong agency and broker relationships throughout the United States. Strategic planning and business leadership. Executive decision-making and judgment. Financial and business acumen. Organizational leadership and change management. Data-driven decision-making and analytical thinking. Negotiation and influencing skills. Executive communication and presentation skills. Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

raw.description:
Lead Ember's Southeast Asia team into its next chapter, shaping the vision, strategy and delivery of our policy work across one of the quickly emerging regions in the clean energy transition.

The Role

Ember is recruiting a Southeast Asia Regional Lead to build on our established, successful team - deepening our influence with regional policymakers and ensuring our analysis lands where decisions are made. You will set the vision, strategy and delivery of our policy programme across the region, leading a team of analysts and researchers, working within Ember’s organisational strategy and the quality standards set by the team director.

You will shape Ember’s strategy for the region, ensure high-quality delivery of the team's outputs and champion Ember's work directly with Southeast Asian policymakers, funders and media. You will also collaborate with our Comms and Data teams to collectively ensure our work lands with real reach and impact.In your first months, you'll work with the Deputy CEO through a defined process to shape how work and roles are organised within the team

This role reports to the Deputy CEO on an interim basis and will report to the team director once that role is in place. You will lead a team with direct line management of up to 4 staff. The team's internal structure is expected to evolve, and you'll play a central role in shaping it during your first months, with support from the Deputy CEO.

About Ember

Ember is an independent, not-for-profit energy think tank that aims to accelerate the clean energy transition with data and policy. We gather, curate and analyse data on the power sector and coal mine methane emissions, and use our findings to improve energy and climate policy.

See our work at and

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and drive Southeast Asia's programme strategy, translating Ember's overall direction into a compelling plan for the region, agreed with the team director.
  • Own delivery of the team's outputs, ensuring high-quality, timely work in line with regional priorities and funder KPIs, acting as the point of quality sign-off for regional outputs within standards agreed across regions
  • Champion and represent the team's work externally with Southeast Asian policymakers, media and partners
  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with Ember's network partners across Southeast Asia, positioning Ember as a reliable, collaborative partner in the region
  • Support funder relationships and grant reporting for the team, working with senior leadership on new fundraising opportunities with fundraising strategy and budget planning led by the team director, with the CEO and Deputy CEO.
  • Mentor and develop the Southeast Asia team, giving clear direction, setting objectives and supporting their growth
  • Co-create a close, day-to-day working relationship with Comms and Data team colleagues, so the three function as one delivery team
  • Coordinate with other Regional Leads to share learnings and align on cross-cutting issues

Location - Remote, based in Southeast Asia. Must have the right to work in your country of residence and be able to attend periodic in-person team meet-ups.

Requirements

Must have

  • Significant experience in a policy, research, or programme leadership role in Southeast Asia, with a track record of setting direction and delivering outputs that lead to real policy impact
  • Solid technical understanding of clean energy transition issues relevant to Southeast Asian countries and experience of influencing the clean energy narrative
  • Line management experience, including managing experienced staff and a track record of developing others with evidence of readiness to grow into managing managers, for example through leading senior colleagues, deputising, or coordinating work across multiple workstreams
  • Confidence representing an organisation's work internally, and externally with policymakers, media and funders
  • A track record of making sound decisions within their remit without needing constant consensus
  • Strong relationships with, or a credible path to building relationships with, Asian funders, policymakers, and media
  • Experience managing distributed or remote teams

Nice to have

  • Existing network of Southeast Asian policymakers, funders, and media contacts
  • Fundraising or grant management experience
  • Experience helping shape or restructure a growing team

We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.

Benefits

Salary: £54,880 per year, based on our standard local cost-of-living adjustment. The salary may be adjusted upwards for candidates based in higher cost-of-living locations in Asia; the applicable salary will be confirmed based on the candidate's location.

Contract: Full time (but only working 9 days every fortnight with no reduction in pay).

Location: Remote, based in Southeast Asia. Must have the right to work in your country of residence and be able to attend periodic in-person team meet-ups.

Further benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package, including:

  • We operate a nine-day fortnight meaning our full-time staff are given every other Friday off work with no reduction in pay
  • A minimum of 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • For each year that you're part of the team at Ember you'll receive an additional day of holiday, up to a maximum of 5 additional days.
  • Flexible working conditions, including the opportunity for part-time work and home working.
  • Access to a local working space can be arranged
  • Free annual eye tests
  • Access to a counselling service
  • Funding and allocated time for your training and development
  • Paid volunteer day
  • Four paid days off per year to enable low carbon travel
  • Time off to donate blood

raw.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

The role is responsible for conducting data collection and analyses to support process improvement programs and projects to reduce cost and complexity across the enterprise. The role will lead a variety of projects in support of the goals of business divisions. Additionally, the incumbent may work in partnership with other BPI colleagues in support of cross-functional enterprise initiatives. The incumbent will draft and review project deliverables and analyses such as value-stream mapping and statistical analyses and supervise business process analysts in the project team environment. The role will also be responsible for business case development using ROI models in direct relationship to departmental goals. The incumbent of this position will interact with process and subject matter experts to develop solutions that improve process performance by increasing productivity and efficiency and/or managing process demands while enhancing the customer experience. In addition to BPI project work, the incumbent must also plan and participate in BPI organization building and activities to help promote the BPI brand, and serve as a mentor to business staff pursuing their Green Lean and Green Belt certifications. This position requires an individual with a strong background in process improvement with the ability to deliver significant sustainable business results.

What You'll Do

Leadership:

  • Experienced process improvement practitioner with a focus on driving cost reduction
  • Execute complex process improvement initiatives with some supervision and guidance
  • Report and communicate the results from process improvement efforts to division
  • Influence business partners to make informed decisions
  • Ability to influence small teams without direct authority
  • Act as a change agent/coach to instill and sustain changes
  • Build positive relationships and credibility with the BPI team and business partners
  • Assess change readiness and prepare plans for helping stakeholders through change
  • Utilize process improvement principles and tools to achieve significant improvement results
  • Direct the analyses of process improvement analysts
  • Drive for high quality results

Process Improvement:

  • Utilize Lean, DMAIC and Design for Six Sigma tools and methodologies to define activities that are aligned with business objectives
  • Identify and manage project risks and issues that impact project progress
  • Prepare detailed plans to track project performance and assure timely completion and achievement of project deliverables
  • Develop practical solutions and methodologies to solve complex business problems
  • Effectively coach, mentor and assist Lean and Green Belt candidates to certification
  • Develop internal and external content for leadership team presentations
  • Ensure deployment of common solutions across divisions and businesses
  • Identify and present new project opportunities to leadership
  • Develop and share best practices among fellow process improvement coaches and clients

​

Financial Management:

  • Partner with Finance and Business to develop and track project metrics
  • Develop business cases using ROI models
  • Develop control plans and monitor performance and improvement in key metrics
  • Deliver significant operational improvement and financial benefits to meet annual targets

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required
  • Bachelor degree preferred or relevant experience in lieu of degree
  • Requires a minimum of 5 years business process improvement or process redesign experience

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

  • Lean Six Sigma Green-level certification from an industry recognized academic or quality institution (e.g. Universities, American Society for Quality) plus the commitment to achieve Horizon Black Belt certification within two years of hire

Knowledge:

  • Healthcare industry experience preferred
  • Experience in a multi-divisional corporate environment desired
  • Understanding of change management challenges related to process improvement
  • Proven project management and process improvement skills including strong knowledge of lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experienced with Minitab and/or other statistical software
  • Must be proficient in MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to lead the work of others
  • Strong verbal/written communication skills, both verbal and in written
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to create strong working relationships with others
  • Ability to gather, synthesize and analyze data and draw logical conclusions
  • Strong project management experience
  • Well organized and results-driven individual

Travel (If Applicable):

  • Occasional travel may be required to alternate Horizon sites

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Salary Range:

$97,800 - $133,455

​This compensation range is specific to the job level and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to: education, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. Horizon also provides a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes:

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Medical/Dental/Vision)

  • Retirement Plans

SMB Team is seeking a Client Success Manager (CSM) for the operational hub of our Client Services Team. This role exists to bridge the gap between strategic vision and day-to-day execution. The CSM is the company's early warning system, crisis coordinator, and feedback loop — preventing escalations before they happen and owning the response when they do.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

📈 An opportunity to be a part of the #1 Fastest Growing Legal Marketing & Coaching Company in the U.S.

🦷 BENEFITS – We pay for 75% of your Medical, Dental, Vision insurance for YOU and YOUR FAMILY.

☀️ FLEXIBLE VACATION TIME - We encourage you to take time to recharge so you can be your best here at work.

💡 EDUCATION – Team member education and learning budget on courses, events and books.

💲 INVESTMENTS – 401(k) with a 3% Match.

💻 WORK STYLE – WFH or come to the office. The choice is yours!

The salary for this role is $85,000 - $90,000 with bonus potential up to $10,000.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 1. Client Health Monitoring:
      • Maintains a real-time view of all active client accounts and their health status
      • Tracks leading indicators: usage trends, support ticket volume, missed milestones, NPS signals
      • Flags at-risk accounts before they escalate
      • Owns and maintains a client health dashboard or tracking system
  • 2. Escalation Prevention:
      • Identifies patterns that precede client escalations and intervenes early
      • Coordinates proactive outreach to clients showing warning signs
      • Works with Team Leads to resolve issues at the team level before they arise
      • Maintains a running log of near-misses and lessons learned
  • 3. Crisis Coordination:
      • Owns the response when a client escalation does occur
      • Assembles and coordinates the right internal resources (cross-functional)
      • Serves as the primary point of communication with the client during a crisis
      • Manages timelines, follow-ups, and resolution commitments
  • 4. SOP Feedback Loop:
      • Conducts a structured debrief after every escalation or near-miss
      • Identifies the process gap that allowed the issue to occur
      • Bring findings to the VP to close gaps in existing SOPs
      • Helps operationalize new procedures with Team Leads
  • 5. Team Lead Enablement:
      • Acts as the primary resource and escalation path for Team Leads
      • Ensures Team Leads have the playbooks, tools, and authority to act
      • Runs regular check-ins with Team Leads to surface emerging client risks
      • Coaches Team Leads on client communication and issue resolution

Requirements

  • 4–6 years in client services, account management, or customer success
  • Calm under pressure; clear communicator when the stakes are high
  • Proven ability to coordinate across departments without direct authority
  • Can spot a broken process, document a fix, and implement it
  • Understands the client's perspective and can de-escalate effectively
  • Familiarity with CRMs, project management, and ticketing systems
  • Has coached or mentored others; comfortable giving direction to peers
  • Extreme ownership mentality — does not wait for others to solve issues
  • High responsiveness and urgency with both clients and internal teams
  • Ability to handle difficult conversations without becoming defensive or emotional
  • Must have proven experience handling high-level client escalations, retention conversations, and difficult client situations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must remain calm, solutions-oriented, and professional under pressure while managing emotionally charged conversations.
  • Must be highly organized with strong follow-through, documentation, and cross-department communication skills.
  • Must be comfortable making judgment calls, identifying risk early, and partnering with leadership on client resolution strategies.

Pluses / Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in digital marketing (SEO, PPC, lifecycle marketing, or agency environments)
  • Familiarity with FCFO / fractional CFO services (cash flow, forecasting, financial reporting)
  • Experience in FCOO / operational leadership or business operations roles
  • Background in customer success, account management, or high-touch client services
  • Experience managing client escalations in fast-paced, service-based environments
  • Understanding of business operations, KPIs, and performance reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with finance, bookkeeping, and operations teams
  • Experience improving or building scalable client success or operational processes

Benefits

SMB Team is a rapidly-growing marketing agency and coaching business for lawyers. After four years of 300% year-over-year growth, we have quickly become one of the top brands in the legal industry.

Bottom Line: We change lives. Want proof? Read our Google My Business reviews.

Educational Brand: We currently run the most prominent talk show in the legal industry. Every week, we get hundreds of lawyers on our webinars by interviewing top thought leaders (as seen on our YouTube). The goal is to become THE source of education for lawyers.

Marketing Services: We offer a full suite of marketing services to our clients, including PPC, SEO, Website Design, Video, and Social Media management. Our goal is to scale our services business to over $15M in revenue in 2023.

Coaching Services: We have a rapidly-growing, Philadelphia-based coaching program for lawyers. In our first year, we built our coaching business into a multi-seven-figure business. Our program has been identified as the most comprehensive coaching program for attorneys, and we plan to double the size of our clients in the next year.

Job Title: Director, Medical Writing WCH

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

About This Role:

As the Director of Medical Writing for the West Coast Hub you are responsible for the writing and/or managing complex marketed and development programs at the portfolio level based on Therapeutic Area, disease state, and/or phase of development. You are also responsible for providing direct supervision for the Medical Writing program leads, including response to potential Medical Writing issues with internal cross-functional teams and external development partners. You will contribute to the long-term growth strategy of the department and ensure that standard procedures are followed across and within projects. You will synchronize prioritization of projects and in some cases, he/she represents Medical Writing in meetings with governance committees, regulatory agencies, and external development partners. Performs outreach within pharmaceutical/biotech industry to maintain knowledge of evolving/emerging industry standards and to establish medical writing best practices within company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Have the knowledge and be independently able to prepare clinical and regulatory documents and packages: protocols and amendments, CSRs, IBs, INDs/CTAs, submissions.Thorough understanding of industry best practices to strategically design documents that fulfil their purpose but written with public disclosure requirements in mind.

  • Lead the planning, development, and delivery of documents according to ICH guidelines, company SOPs, templates, and regulatory requirements.Support the development and maintenance of SOPs and templates for document development.

  • Ability to critically analyze and synthesize complex scientific information, and ensure scientific accuracy and consistency of documents.Develop and integrate messaging and medical writing strategy and ensure consistency through documents in a therapeutic area and/or disease state.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional SMEs including (but not limited to), Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Operations.

  • Participate in regulatory submission planning, timelines, and document development.

  • Manage and/or provide oversight of in-house and/or contractor/vendor medical writers, ensuring high-quality deliverables.Mentor and provide professional development guidance to junior writers. May serve as the MW liaison for one or more Functional Service Providers (FSP)

  • Provide mentoring and career development to direct reports to create a high-quality and productive group.

  • Review statistical analysis plans and clinical data reports that are incorporated in data-related documents (CSRs, IBs, etc).Provide strategic input to TFL outputs to streamline TFL production.

  • Lead departmental initiatives as necessary.

Who You Are:

In addition to having exceptional written and communication skills, you successfully worked in a matrix environment where you collaborated with other clinical teams. You have strong regulatory writing experience and strong teamwork capabilities.You have expert knowledge of global requirements related to all aspects of clinical regulatory documentation to support all phases of clinical development (Phase 1-4), and acts as a medical writing subject matter expert to other departments. You have a demonstrated management, scientific, and customer-focused leadership skills.People management skill is nice to have but not must have.

Required Skills

  • Minimum of BSc + 12 years’ experience in Medical Writing, or Advanced degree + 7 years’ experience in Medical Writing (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO setting)

  • Experience with global regulatory submissions (e.g. BLA/NDA, MAA)

  • Familiarity with eCTD format and relationships between documents.

  • Familiarity with ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines and regulations, as well as public disclosure requirements for documents.

  • Proven experience authoring documents and leading teams through the authoring process.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • SME in MS Word, and proficiency in document management systems (Veeva, SharePoint).

  • Experience in managing and/or mentoring other medical writers or external vendors preferred

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $191,000.00-$263,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.


At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.

raw.description:
Location
Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

  • Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
  • Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
  • Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
  • Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
  • API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
  • Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
  • Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
  • Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
  • Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
  • Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
  • Working proficiency in SQL
  • Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
  • A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
  • AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
  • Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

  • Experience building integration platforms or extensibility frameworks as a core part of a product
  • Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
  • Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
  • Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
  • Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do'er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

raw.description:
VetsEZ is seeking a Data Quality Analyst & Testerto support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Data Migration and Management (DMM) Support Services for Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM). This role is critical to ensure that data migrated from VistA through VX130 to Oracle Health is complete, correct, traceable, and ready to support bulk migration, cutover, and VA site go-live activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute and monitor daily Data Quality (DQ) checks across multiple VA sites and large datasets using DMM / IRIS data-quality tools.
  • Investigate data-quality discrepancies, identify root causes, coordinate corrective actions, and drive issues through resolution to protect Data Migration integrity.
  • Validate migration queries, extracts, transformed data, and transmitted data for completeness and correctness in support of bulk migration, cutover, and site go-live activities.
  • Partner with InterSystems IRIS developers, VA staff, Oracle Health, and appropriate SMEs to research and resolve migration-data discrepancies and validation issues.
  • Prepare, maintain, and support weekly Data Quality reporting demonstrating results against VA / DMM-defined standards, and provide accurate status for Weekly Progress Reporting.
  • Gather requirements, implement, test, and deploy new or enhanced Data Quality capabilities, checks, queries, and reporting functions.
  • Create, validate, and troubleshoot SQL queries and data extracts across multiple clinical and administrative data domains.
  • Monitor DQ applications and supporting environments, identify application/server issues, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate engineering or platform teams.
  • Administer DQ application access and permissions as assigned and maintain accurate documentation of DQ tools, checks, processes, and operating procedures.
  • Facilitate recurring Data Quality meetings and communicate status, findings, risks, and resolution plans clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Use and support DMM applications such as the Data Quality Tool, Data Quality Control Panel, Journal File Search, Enterprise Domain Activity by Site, Query Management Tool, Cutover Check Application, Data Migration Event Tracker, and DMM Ticketing System.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience performing data validation, data-quality analysis, testing, reconciliation, or troubleshooting across large datasets.
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to create and validate ad hoc queries used for investigation and reconciliation.
  • Experience with automation, monitoring, data mapping, testing, or analytical tools.
  • Knowledge of database architecture, data integrity concepts, and security considerations for on-premises and cloud-hosted systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies, identify patterns, and communicate clear findings and recommended actions.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions and present findings to customers and stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with InterSystems IRIS / Caché, VistA, VX130, or VA healthcare data.
  • Familiarity with Linux, Kubernetes / containers, Power BI, GitHub / Azure DevOps, and Agile / Scrum environments.
  • Experience supporting data migration, cutover validation, or healthcare data reconciliation.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal healthcare environments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Government background investigation / access authorization.

Security Clearance Requirements:

U.S. Citizenship is required.

All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.

Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

• 401(k) with Employer Match

• PTO and Federal Holidays

• Corporate-provided Laptop

  • Training and Professional Development Opportunities

• Fully Remote Role

Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

About the team

The Rentals Sales Team is dedicated to delivering top-notch advertising solutions and business consultation for our Multi-Family partners. Composed of passionate and high-energy professionals, we are committed to helping Zillow Group users make informed decisions about buying, renting, owning, and selling homes. Specifically, our Rentals Enterprise team collaborates with the largest owners and operators of rental properties across the United States, facilitating connections between rental shoppers and their next home. Through innovative technology solutions, strategic data insights, and comprehensive training and development, we empower our clients' growth as true partners in their business. Our team embodies the core values of our organization and plays a vital role in driving our success.

About the role

We are looking for an exceptional Enterprise Business Advisor to drive exponential growth in the Rentals marketplace. In this role, you will be responsible for growing revenue, driving listing growth, and achieving overall growth targets by effectively closing opportunities and retaining existing Enterprise partnerships. As a key player in our fast-paced and ever-evolving business, you will play a critical role in our success not only in 2026 but also in the future. This position offers the opportunity to make a daily impact on the overall business.

The Business Advisor role is critical to our continued success, and as such, the successful candidate will be expected to achieve the following objectives:

  • Drive the new business sales cycle including identifying potential decision makers within existing portfolios, resolving prospect needs, overcoming objections, negotiating, and closing.

  • Be an expert in all Zillow Rentals Network products and services.

  • Perform a high volume of nationally based calls and face-to-face meetings to secure new business, upsell revenue, and increase partner participation.

  • Continually expand knowledge of industry trends, market conditions, competitors, and advertising tendencies to maintain deep expertise in the Rentals landscape.

  • Utilize Salesforce.com to prospect, log activity, manage your calendar, and track opportunities.

  • Participate in conferences, association meetings, tradeshows, and property management company meetings to grow partnerships, revenue, and Zillow Rentals visibility.

  • Initiate new relationships within the industry through referrals, associations, and networking.

  • Meet and exceed assigned sales quota on a quarterly basis.

  • Demonstrate the ability to excel in high-level conversations, including frequent engagement with C-suite leaders and multi-business-unit stakeholders, to drive strategic enterprise growth.

The application window is expected to close on: 09/17/2026

Meet the Team

The GTM Strategy & Operations team for Splunk is the strategic engine behind Splunk's go-to-market motion, partnering directly with the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) organization to shape sales strategy, planning, and executive decision-making. We translate market dynamics, business performance, and sales data into the frameworks and recommendations that guide how Splunk goes to market.

The team operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and operations - developing GTM frameworks, running independent analyses, and delivering executive-ready recommendations that directly influence CRO-level priorities and investment decisions.

Our team members are trusted advisors to senior leadership: independent, analytically rigorous, and comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end. We value clear thinking, sharp executive communication, and a collaborative approach to solving cross-functional business challenges.

Your Impact

As the Strategy & Planning Lead on the GTM Strategy & Operations team, you will lead strategic projects supporting Splunk's CRO organization largely independently, with light guidance from your manager. You will build direct, trusted relationships with senior executives, translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, and develop the GTM frameworks that shape strategic decisions across the sales organization.

You bring strong analytical rigor, executive presence, and a track record of owning complex strategic work from framing through recommendation - and you're comfortable moving between deep quantitative analysis and polished executive storytelling.

● Independently lead strategic GTM projects end-to-end - from problem framing and analysis through executive-ready recommendations - requiring minimal day-to-day direction.

● Build and manage relationships with senior executives and cross-functional leaders, serving as a trusted strategic partner to the CRO organization.

● Develop and apply GTM frameworks and models to evaluate market opportunities, sales strategy options, and business performance.

● Conduct deep quantitative and qualitative analyses, synthesizing sales, pipeline, and business data into clear, actionable executive insights.

● Build and deliver polished, executive-ready presentations and business models (Excel, PowerPoint) for CRO and senior leadership reviews.

● Partner cross-functionally with sales, marketing, finance, product, and, operations to align GTM priorities and drive execution against strategic plans.

● Own analysis, reporting, and materials for recurring strategic planning cycles and executive business reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

● Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

● 7+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business/sales operations, strategic planning, or management consulting.

● Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with demonstrated ability to build financial/business models and executive-ready presentations.

● Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex strategic initiatives from ambiguity to executive-ready recommendations.

● Strong executive presence, business writing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership.

● Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into strategic insight.

Preferred Qualifications

● Working knowledge of SQL, Salesforce (SFDC), and/or Tableau for data extraction and analysis.

● Experience developing GTM or strategic planning frameworks used to guide executive decision-making.

● Background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or sales/business operations.

● Proven experience managing relationships with C-suite or senior executive stakeholders.

● Familiarity with Cisco/Splunk's business, sales motion, or enterprise B2B software GTM.

● Self-driven and highly proactive, with a track record of operating effectively with minimal oversight.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
