raw.description:
BioDigital is searching for a Strategic Account Director to manage and expand enterprise accounts, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure clients fully utilize their cloud-based, interactive 3D human body visualization platform and realize its value in enhancing health education and understanding. This role requires a strong background in SaaS and/or healthcare sales, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a passion for making healthcare accessible to everyone.

Who we are

BioDigital has built the first cloud-based solution for visualizing the human body in interactive 3D. Like Google Earth for the human body, our cutting-edge technology empowers patients, educators, and professionals worldwide with an engaging, visual way to learn about health and medicine. Our team is on a mission to make health and the human body understandable to all, and we’re seeking a talented, customer-centric Strategic Account Director to help execute on our ambitious goals.

Who you are

Ideally, you'll have a proven track record in selling and managing cloud-based software solutions, particularly within healthcare, life sciences, or medical technology. You are skillful and passionate about developing and managing high-value, complex client relationships by deeply understanding their needs, proactively identifying opportunities to expand business within the account, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver strategic solutions that align with the client's long-term goals. You enjoy collaboration with sales, product, content, and customer success teams to help clients realize the value of our platform. You are detail oriented, a creative problem solver, and have a personal connection to our mission of helping people better understand their health.

What you’ll do

  • Own and manage a book of our largest enterprise accounts with revenue growth, renewal and retention targets.
  • Identify and qualify new expansion opportunities within existing accounts, proactively presenting value propositions and driving incremental revenue growth ensuring a healthy pipeline for consistent revenue growth.
  • Manage account renewals and proactively identify opportunities to introduce additional products and services that align with customer objectives, driving increased value.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans, identifying potential growth areas, key decision-makers, and strategic initiatives, focusing on upsell and product adoption (perhaps add something like: maximize revenue and customer value).
  • Proactively identify and understand evolving customer needs, challenges, and pain points, while building strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders. Use this insight to develop tailored solutions that address their specific objectives and help achieve their business goals.
  • Own the overall success of the account by leading cross-functional collaboration, bringing in specialists (e.g., Account Executive, Integration Engineer, Product Manager, Science Lead, and Training/Onboarding team) as needed. Work closely with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and timely delivery of solutions.
  • Monitor customer satisfaction and track key account metrics, address concerns promptly, and ensure successful implementation and ongoing usage of solutions to maintain strong client relationships.
  • Provide accurate forecasting and account updates in CRM, maintaining detailed records of client interactions, sales stages, and follow-up activities. Provide insights to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Build value-based relationships with key executive level decision makers by leveraging existing client relationships and building new ones.
  • Represent BioDigital at industry events or trade shows.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 5-10 years experience in a key account director, strategic account director or enterprise sales role.
  • Proven track record of achieving revenue targets and managing complex, high-value accounts within a B2B environment.
  • Strategic thinker with demonstrated ability to create account management plans and build trusted relationships throughout strategic accounts.
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to achieve shared goals. Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to understand customer needs and tailor solutions accordingly.
  • Inquisitive by nature and interested in uncovering issues to identify business opportunities.
  • Detail oriented and committed to high quality deliverables.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship building skills at the executive level.
  • Creative problem-solving attitude.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams to achieve goals without positional authority.
  • Experience working with B2B SaaS products and/or medical device or life sciences companies preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time for internal meetings, client meetings, trade shows and events
The hiring range for this position is $130,000- $140,000 base per year with the opportunity for variable compensation based on successful renewals and upsells. The actual offer may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

Equal Opportunity Workplace

BioDigital is committed to equal employment opportunity and to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All hiring decisions are based on business need, job requirements and individual qualifications, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, parental status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.
Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and eager-to-learn Number Operations Specialist (Entry Level) to join our Number Operations team. In this role, you will help manage the process of transferring telephone numbers between carriers, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and a smooth experience for our customers. You'll support porting-related requests, number purchasing, Caller ID, and A2P 10DLC SMS registration inquiries, working closely with internal teams, customers, and external carriers to resolve issues. This is a great opportunity to build a foundation in telecom operations — full training will be provided.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks at once
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable learning new software tools (CRM/ticketing systems such as Zendesk or Jira)
  • Eagerness to learn about telecom, VoIP, and number portability processes
  • No prior telecom experience required — training provided

Skills & Competencies:

  • Organized with good time management
  • Problem-solving mindset with a customer-first attitude
  • Willingness to ask questions and escalate issues appropriately
  • Team player who collaborates well across departments
  • Interest in working with data and spotting patterns over time

Why join us?

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
💵 Competitive salary package & benefits
🏨 Medical, dental, and vision insurance is 100% covered
📈 401k plan with company matching!
✈️ Unlimited PTO — take the time you need to come to work feeling great!
⭐️ Wellness, internet, and childcare reimbursements
💚 Generous parental leave policy
DE&I Statement:
At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.
We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.
We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

raw.description:
The main purpose of the Ads Creative Strategist is to provide our clients with top-quality creative media. This may include researching and reaching out to potential content creators and keeping up-to-date with the ever-changing TikTok and Instagram Reels trends.

The Ad Creative Strategist will need to develop a deep understanding of each individual client’s brand, values, customer avatars, and specific requirements. This knowledge will be used to create detailed script briefs for chosen content creators, matching their brand guidelines and including full video footage concepts for the creative campaign.

In addition, the Ads Creative Strategist will be required to contact and liaise with potential content creators in order to put a team together for each project. Performing quality control duties on the received content to ensure that it meets guidelines will also be a part of this role.

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Ads Creative Strategist is to ensure that we provide the highest quality creative ads possible to our clients. This involves gaining a deep understanding of each client’s unique needs, brand voice, values, and messaging, as well as maintaining an in-depth understanding of and keeping up with changing trends.

As our Ads Creative Strategist, you’ll be working closely with content creators of your own choosing, whom you’ll be required to research, reach out to, and liaise with throughout the project. You may be required to communicate directly with clients on occasion.

General Responsibilities:

  • Strategizing script briefs based on current TikTok and Instagram trends.
  • Preparing detailed script briefs for content creators, including B-roll footage required.
  • Researching content creators to match each brand’s Customer Avatar goal for each testing concept.
  • Communicating with potential content creators regarding the scope of each project.
  • Ensuring the quality of Video Ad variations.
  • Selecting and arranging a content creator for each project.
  • Ensuring the quality of the content provided by the content creators.
  • Providing feedback on content received.
  • Keeping up with ongoing TikTok and Reels trends.
  • Assisting with any other tasks as required by the Product Manager.

Positions Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours.
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement.
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing).
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first month.

Requirements

The Ads Creative Strategist should possess a creative flair and a comprehensive understanding of social media trends and algorithms, particularly TikTok and Instagram Reels. Additionally, you will need to be able to identify and strategize for various customer avatars’ pain points, across a variety of different niches.

Great communication skills are a must, as you’ll be communicating with potential content creators, the rest of the creative team, and occasionally with clients. The right person for this job will also have excellent organizational skills, time management skills, and be able to plan ahead effectively.

Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in coming up with engaging creative content across a range of niches.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of social media trends, with particular emphasis on TikTok and Instagram Reels.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with content creators, colleagues, and clients.
  • The ability to come up with creative concepts based on current and foreseeable trends.
  • Must possess strong presentation, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills to effectively deliver work of high quality promptly.
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines.
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically.
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism.
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage.
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus).
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time).
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (you must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language).
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team.

Overview of Position
Are you energized by bringing structure to complex client work, turning data into practical recommendations, and making sure important commitments reach the finish line? Join Assurant as an Account Manager supporting lender-placed insurance clients. You’ll partner closely with experienced Account Executives and teams across Operations, Business Relationship Management, projects, claims, underwriting, customer care, and other areas to keep client priorities visible, organized, and moving forward.

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys both relationship building and hands-on execution. You’ll lead recurring client conversations, coordinate deliverables, monitor performance, support audits and business reviews, and help resolve concerns before they become recurring problems. You do not need prior lender-placed insurance experience to be successful. We’re looking for someone with strong professional judgment, reliable follow-through, and the ability to learn a complex business while building trusted partnerships.

Ready to bring structure, insight, and dependable follow-through to important client relationships? Apply today and help shape a better client experience across Assurant’s Lending Solutions business!

What makes us different?

  • 100% work-from-home opportunity for U.S.-based employees.

  • Day-one benefits, generous paid time off, and holiday pay.

  • 401(k) plan with Assurant matching 100% of employee contributions up to 6% of eligible pay.

  • Broad exposure across Lending Solutions and multiple business functions, creating meaningful opportunities to learn and grow.

  • Career-development resources that may include internal courses, workshops, special projects, coaching, mentoring, tuition reimbursement, and professional enrichment opportunities.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Support the day-to-day relationship and delivery for assigned lender-placed insurance clients, representing client needs while balancing Assurant’s operational, contractual, regulatory, and business responsibilities.

  • Lead recurring client and internal meetings, including preparing agendas and updates, presenting progress and concerns, documenting decisions, and driving clear follow-through.

  • Maintain task plans, project trackers, audit matrices, and action logs that keep commitments, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and client expectations organized and visible.

  • Coordinate client requests, audits, implementations, complaints, service concerns, and operational issues across internal partners, maintaining ownership through resolution or an agreed next step.

  • Analyze reporting, service levels, scorecards, claims, operational trends, and client feedback to identify risks and recommend improvements to service, workflows, documentation, processes, or efficiencies.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in mortgage loan servicing, financial services, insurance, or another professional business environment.

  • Ability to balance and manage multiple needs, deliverables, and competing priorities while meeting deadlines and maintaining strong follow-through.

What other skills or experience would be helpful to have?

  • Strong relationship building, work coordination, organization, and professional presentation skills.

  • Ability to analyze client, customer, or operational data and translate findings into practical recommendations.

  • What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

  • General office demands. This is a remote position that requires regular use of a computer, participation in video and telephone meetings, and the ability to manage detailed work across multiple systems and deadlines.

How much should I expect to travel?
This is a fully remote position, but there is limited travel expected up to 10%. Generally 2-3 times per year, with additional travel potentially possible based on client or business needs.

Pay Range:

$56,200.00 - $94,100.00

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

If there is no posting end date listed then this is a pipeline requisition, and we will continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis.


Helping People Thrive in a Connected World
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at .

For U.S. benefit information, visit myassurantbenefits.com. For benefit information outside the U.S., please speak with your recruiter.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert
Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

raw.description:
About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities supporting U.S. and Canadian companies. We focus on long-term placements where experienced professionals can take real ownership, become trusted members of the team, and make a measurable impact from anywhere.

About the Role

As a Medical Administrative & Surgical Patient Coordinator, you will own the administrative coordination that happens after a patient begins moving through the surgical process. You will make sure required clearances, testing, records, appointments, documentation, and pre-operative steps are completed so patients stay on track for surgery.

This is an operations-focused healthcare role, not a sales position and not a remote clinical position. You will work directly with patients, medical offices, imaging centers, laboratories, hospitals, and other healthcare providers while knowing when a question or concern needs to be escalated to clinical staff. You will receive training on the practice's specific workflows and gradually take ownership of a critical part of the patient journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own and track the pre-operative process for multiple surgical patients from booking through readiness for surgery.
  • Keep each patient's pre-operative checklist current, identifying missing clearances, tests, records, documentation, and other requirements before they become delays.
  • Coordinate required appointments and testing, including imaging, medical clearances, laboratory work, and other pre-operative requirements.
  • Contact hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare facilities to obtain outstanding information and keep cases moving.
  • Follow up persistently with outside providers when testing, records, or clearances are delayed, advocating for patients while maintaining professional communication.
  • Conduct or support standardized pre-operative patient calls and clearly walk patients through established non-clinical instructions and next steps.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient conversations, completed requirements, pending items, and case status within the appropriate systems.
  • Communicate surgical readiness, outstanding requirements, and potential delays clearly to the broader practice team.
  • Recognize clinical questions, unusual circumstances, or concerns that fall outside your administrative scope and escalate them promptly rather than providing independent medical advice.
  • Provide additional medical administrative and patient-coordination support when needed to improve the efficiency of the surgical process.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in medical administration, surgical coordination, patient coordination, pre-operative coordination, or closely related healthcare operations.
  • Hands-on experience working in a U.S. medical practice or healthcare environment.
  • Direct experience coordinating surgical or pre-operative patients, including appointments, tests, medical records, clearances, or required documentation.
  • Experience using EMR, CRM, patient-management, or comparable medical-office systems.
  • Confidence communicating directly with patients and contacting hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare providers.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with strong documentation, organization, case-tracking, and follow-through skills.
  • Sound judgment regarding administrative versus clinical responsibilities, including knowing when an issue must be escalated to clinical staff.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in plastic surgery, cosmetic surgery, aesthetics, or another high-touch private-pay medical environment.
  • Medical Assistant training, nursing-related education, healthcare education, or equivalent clinical-office experience.
  • Experience conducting standardized pre-operative patient calls.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

The Motorola Solutions' Enterprise Marketing team supports physical security, enterprise radio and resilience solutions used by customers around the world. From education and healthcare to financial, retail and government agencies, organizations depend on Motorola Solutions for safety and security.


Job Description

Motorola Solutions is looking for an experienced Product Marketing Manager to own our specialty camera portfolio, including our ruggedized, PTZ, explosion-protected and anti-corrosion camera lines.

As a Product Marketer, you will work across Marketing and with Product Management and Sales to develop and deliver exceptional marketing and messaging. You will be tasked with driving strategy and go-to-market plans, bringing new products and features to market, and promoting cloud product and service offerings. Your focus will be on crafting messaging, creating marketing assets and sales enablement materials, and supporting campaigns for customers and partners.

Who you are

  • You are a creative storyteller with excellent communication skills that span writing, speaking and presenting

  • You are curious, asking questions and open to learning new technologies, new audiences and new markets

  • You can admit mistakes, and have the ability to learn from them and move forward.

  • You can take complex products or features and distill them into clear, concise, value-focused messages

  • You have the talent to create compelling and exciting messages to differentiate your product in the market

  • You are organized, with excellent follow-up skills, and can take ownership of projects and see them to completion

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments and can build relationships across teams to drive the greatest impact

  • You can creatively problem solve, and adapt to shifting projects and moving targets.

What you'll do

  • Partner with Product Management to be the voice of the customer

  • Craft messaging and positioning that demonstrates the value of your solution and differentiates it in the market

  • Acquire deep customer knowledge through market research, customer interviews, and segmentation analysis

  • Conduct competitor and market research to better understand our differentiation, target customers, key industries, and buyer personas

  • Create and execute go-to-market strategies to drive product awareness, adoption, and pipeline

  • Work with Integrated Marketing to develop and execute marketing campaigns to increase awareness and drive demand for products and solutions

  • Develop internal and external facing content to enable Sales to effectively position and sell our video security solutions.

  • Design and execute channel marketing strategy and collateral to drive adoption, including training, tool kits, and enablement materials

  • Own product and feature launches, including messaging and positioning, identifying target audiences, and creating content to support the launch, such as web pages, social media, collateral, presentations, and more

Qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience in Product Marketing or similar field, preferably in B2B

  • Degree concentration in marketing, business, or related field

  • Experience working with combined hardware and software solutions a plus, with an emphasis on prior experience in the physical security space

Target Base Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000 CAD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


Basic Requirements

  • 5 years of experience in Product Marketing or similar field, preferably in B2B

  • Legal authorization to work in Canada indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position. (Perm Resident/Citizen Only)


Travel Requirements

Under 25%

None

Experienced

Yes


EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

raw.description:
THE ROLE

Gorilla Commerce is seeking a Manager, PLM & Product Data to serve as the business owner and super-user of the company's PLM platform.

Gorilla Commerce has successfully implemented PLM as the system of record for product specifications, BOMs, materials, suppliers and costing, and the platform is live across the sourcing organization. This role owns it from here — closing the residual data gaps that follow any implementation, raising the standard of governance, and maturing the platform through its next phases of capability.

The scope is broad but well supported. Sourcing teams own day-to-day data entry and maintenance following go-live. A dedicated analyst supports bulk uploads, reconciliation and heavy data work. IT leads the technical build of the PLM–ERP integration. This role sets the standards, makes the system decisions, and directs the work.

There is genuine white space here. An 18-month roadmap is defined — stronger specification and BOM structure, packaging and artwork governance, warning-label and claims data — and the person in this role will shape how it is prioritized, sequenced and delivered.

The role can be based globally and works core US Eastern hours to stay aligned with the VP and the wider team, with some flexibility for Asia-based sourcing partners.

This is not a data-entry or system-administration role. It is a product-data ownership role focused on structure, governance, adoption and system maturity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

System Ownership & Configuration

  • Own the day-to-day health, configuration and evolution of the PLM platform.

  • Act as the internal authority on how PLM should be structured and used across parent and SKU hierarchy, specifications, BOMs, materials, supplier and factory records, quotes and costing.

  • Determine whether an issue is best solved through configuration, data architecture, process design or vendor development.

  • Own integration keys and mappings between PLM and the ERP.

Product Data Governance & Integrity

  • Own product data quality as an ongoing discipline rather than a periodic cleanup.

  • Establish validation standards, naming conventions and audit routines that prevent errors upstream.

  • Reconcile PLM against ERP master data and resolve discrepancies at root cause.

  • Close residual implementation gaps across product hierarchy, suppliers and factories, BOMs, color/size and supplier quote data.

Workflow, Change & Version Control

  • Design and govern state models, approval workflows and revision control.

  • Define how specification and BOM changes are requested, approved, tested and released.

  • Assess downstream impact of data and configuration changes before release.

  • Establish clear decision rights across this role, functional owners, IT and leadership.

Adoption, Training & Process Discipline

  • Drive adoption across a distributed sourcing organization as a core deliverable of the role.

  • Build and maintain SOPs, training materials and onboarding for new users.

  • Move remaining product workflows off spreadsheets and email and into PLM.

  • Identify recurring process failures and resolve the root cause rather than the symptom.

Vendor Partnership & Roadmap

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with the PLM software vendor.

  • Manage tickets, requirements, testing and feature scoping independently, escalating commercial matters to the VP.

  • Own the business-side PLM roadmap and translate business needs into practical system and process solutions.

  • Sequence future capability including deeper Level 2 and 3 BOM structure, packaging governance and claims data.

Integration Support

  • Support the IT-led PLM–ERP integration through requirements definition, mapping validation and UAT.

  • Diagnose whether issues originate in source data, PLM configuration, integration logic or the ERP.

  • Keep integration keys complete and accurate across all active SKUs.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 5+ years in PLM, product data management or product operations, including direct ownership of a PLM or comparable product-data platform.

  • Strong grasp of product hierarchy, multi-level BOMs, specifications and revision management.

  • Experience maintaining product data integrity against an ERP, including reconciliation and integration keys.

  • Experience designing or governing approval workflows and version control.

  • Advanced Excel and confident handling of large product datasets.

  • Excellent written and verbal English.

Preferred

  • Experience through a PLM implementation or major system rollout.

  • Vendor management experience with software providers.

  • Experience in Centric PLM would be a plus.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, integration mapping and UAT.

  • Python, SQL or Power Query for data reconciliation and automation.

  • Exposure to packaging, artwork or compliance documentation data.

  • Background in consumer products, retail, sourcing, manufacturing, apparel, footwear or hardlines.

Competencies

  • High ownership and accountability

  • Strong systems and structured-data thinking

  • Comfortable acting as a data gatekeeper

  • Independent problem solver — brings recommendations, not questions

  • Clear communicator across time zones and functions

  • Builds processes and standards that scale

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

  • PLM is live, but no single person owns its structure, standards and evolution.

  • Product data underpins sourcing, costing, compliance, quality and planning.

  • Residual implementation gaps need closing — and preventing.

  • Adoption determines whether the platform delivers its value.

  • This role exists to own PLM end to end, raise data standards, drive adoption and deliver the roadmap.

Frontline is preparing for potential upcoming disaster-response call orders and is building a pipeline of qualified candidates who may be considered for future Disaster Response Helpline Agent opportunities.

Disaster-response needs can change quickly based on weather events, emergency declarations, and client needs. Building the pipeline in advance allows us to identify qualified candidates and complete required preliminary steps so we are prepared to move quickly when additional support is requested.

This posting is for a candidate pipeline and does not guarantee immediate employment, placement, hours, or a specific start date.

Position Overview

Disaster Response Helpline Agents provide customer service support to individuals and families impacted by disasters or emergencies. Depending on the call order, responsibilities may include:

  • Answering high volumes of inbound calls
  • Assisting callers with disaster assistance applications and case-status questions
  • Providing accurate information regarding available assistance, documentation requirements, and recovery resources
  • Documenting caller interactions and case information accurately within secure systems
  • Following established procedures and escalation processes
  • Providing professional, patient, and empathetic support to callers who may be experiencing stressful situations

Candidate Qualifications

Candidates should have:

  • Strong verbal communication and active-listening skills
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Patience, empathy, and professionalism
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems and applications simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Dependable attendance
  • Flexibility to support changing schedules based on call-order needs
  • Potential availability for evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during disaster activations

Bilingual Spanish/English candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

Homeland Security Submission Requirements

Candidates interested in being considered for the submission list will be required to complete the applicable Homeland Security forms and documentation.

Potential employment is contingent upon successful completion of the required Homeland Security background and suitability process.

Completing the forms or being submitted for consideration does not guarantee employment or assignment to a future call order.

Required Technical Setup

Candidates must also meet Frontline's technical requirements before being approved for placement:

  • Windows desktop computer only; Macs, Chromebooks, and laptop-only setups are not permitted
  • Recent-generation Intel i5, i7, or i9 processor, or AMD Ryzen 5, 7, or 9
  • 16 GB RAM with at least 12 GB usable
  • Dual monitors
  • High-quality USB headset
  • Hardwired Ethernet connection at all times to maintain required performance standards and KPIs

Candidates may be required to complete a technical review to verify that their equipment and internet setup meet Frontline requirements.

Important

Placement and employment will depend on future call-order needs and are contingent upon:

  • Successful completion of Homeland Security background and suitability requirements
  • Completion of all required onboarding documentation
  • Meeting Frontline technical requirements
  • Successful completion of required training and assessments
  • Client and project staffing needs at the time of activation

Candidates who are interested in being considered for future disaster-response opportunities are encouraged to apply and complete the requested documentation so they can be reviewed for inclusion in the submission pipeline.

In this role, you will be crucial to delivering sophisticated solutions to our clients, covering Application Development, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Machine Learning. A key component of this position is specialized experience migrating workloads from on-premise data centers to the AWS cloud (Rehost and Replatform Migration), thereby empowering clients to maximize the benefits of cloud infrastructure.

What you will do:

  • Serve as an Infrastructure Migration Specialist and Solution Architect, specializing in migrating workloads from on-premise data centers to the AWS cloud (Rehost and Replatform Migration).

  • Spearhead Platform Engineering initiatives, focusing on large-scale Lift and Shift (REHOST) and REPLATFORM migrations targeting AWS EC2 instance-based architectures.

  • Plan and execute migration tasks using AWS services (Migration Hub, MGN, SMS, DMS) and migration tools such as CloudEndure and Double-Take.

  • Conduct portfolio assessment and use tools like AWS Migration Evaluator to analyze and define optimal migration strategies.

  • Troubleshoot Windows or Linux OS and Database server issues during migration to ensure a seamless transition.

  • Empower clients to maximize the benefits of cloud infrastructure

Basic Qualifications (BQ):

  • Proficiency in Architecting, deploying and maintaining AWS Cloud based infrastructure services [VPC, IAM, S3, Lambda, EC2, SQS, SSM, ASG, Cloudwatch, Cloudtrail, Boto3, Python, EKS, Shell Scripting, Automation, SNS, SQS, KMS, EKS, ECR, RDS. etc]

  • Good Understanding of medium to large Enterprise architectures, Multi-Account AWS setup.

Cloud Migration Expertise:

  • Recent experience with and a strong understanding of various cloud migration strategies (the 7 Rs).

  • Must have experience with at least one large-scale Lift and Shift (REHOST) migration and one large-scale REPLATFORM migration, targeting AWS EC2 instance-based architectures.

  • Prior experience using migration tools such as CloudEndure and Double-Take, as well as AWS services.

  • Proficient in utilizing AWS services for migration, including Migration Hub, AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), and AWS Server Migration Service (SMS).

  • Familiarity with Database servers is a plus, along with proficiency in the Migration Service (SMS) and AWS Database Migration Service (DMS).

  • Expertise in AWS services, including EC2, S3, auto-scaling, Landing Zone, and Control Tower

  • Proficiency in using AWS Migration Evaluator and Portfolio Assessment tools to analyze migration strategies

  • Well-versed in service-oriented architecture and cloud-based web services architecture, design patterns, and frameworks

  • Good understanding of Windows or Linux OS. Experience with troubleshooting Linux/Windows OS issues while migrating. Good to have handled Database server migrations also.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud-related services such as compute, storage, network, and messaging (e.g., SNS, SQS).

Networking Skills:

  • Proficiency in setting up and managing hybrid cloud networks, including VPN and AWS Direct Connect.

  • Experience with configuring Application Load Balancers (ALB) for effective traffic management

Automation and Deployment:

  • Proficient in scripting languages such as Python and Bash for automating migration tasks and processes.

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, including AWS CloudFormation and Terraform.

  • Strong understanding of IaC practices using tools like Terraform, CDK, and CloudFormation Templates.

  • Experience in automating development and testing processes through CI/CD pipelines using tools like Git, Jenkins, SonarQube, Artifactory, and Docker containers.

Security and Compliance:

  • Strong understanding of AWS security best practices, including setting up IAM roles and policies for secure access.

  • Knowledge of compliance requirements relevant to data handling and migration processes.

Configuration Management / Scripting and Programming:

  • Hands-on experience with scripting and programming languages such as Bash, Python, Core Java, and Scala.

  • Previous work experience on Configuration management and using tools like Ansible, Chef, Puppet, AWS SSM, etc.

Other Qualifications (OQ):

  • Familiarity on-prem VMware ecosystem such as vSphere, vCenter, ESX, NSX.

  • Familiarity with vMotion, VM Export/Import and integrating with AWS.

  • Skills in monitoring cloud infrastructure and application performance using tools like Amazon CloudWatch.

  • Experience in optimizing database queries and application performance following migration.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer).

  • Experience with relational SQL, NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).

  • Ability to build and manage container hosting platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, AWS EKS.

  • Familiarity with systems management and automation tools like Puppet, Chef, and Ansible.

  • Experience working in an Agile and DevOps environment.

What is in it for you:

  • Join one of the world’s fastest-growing AI-first digital engineering companies and make a real impact at scale.

  • Lead and collaborate with a high-energy team of talented, driven individuals solving complex, meaningful challenges.

  • Work with Fortune 500 companies and disruptive innovators in a research-driven environment with 60+ patents.

  • Stay ahead of the curve by gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies while continuously upskilling.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

raw.description:
About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities supporting U.S. and Canadian companies. We focus on long-term placements where experienced professionals can take real ownership, become trusted members of the team, and make a measurable impact from anywhere.

About the Role

As a Medical Administrative & Surgical Patient Coordinator, you will own the administrative coordination that happens after a patient begins moving through the surgical process. You will make sure required clearances, testing, records, appointments, documentation, and pre-operative steps are completed so patients stay on track for surgery.

This is an operations-focused healthcare role, not a sales position and not a remote clinical position. You will work directly with patients, medical offices, imaging centers, laboratories, hospitals, and other healthcare providers while knowing when a question or concern needs to be escalated to clinical staff. You will receive training on the practice's specific workflows and gradually take ownership of a critical part of the patient journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own and track the pre-operative process for multiple surgical patients from booking through readiness for surgery.
  • Keep each patient's pre-operative checklist current, identifying missing clearances, tests, records, documentation, and other requirements before they become delays.
  • Coordinate required appointments and testing, including imaging, medical clearances, laboratory work, and other pre-operative requirements.
  • Contact hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare facilities to obtain outstanding information and keep cases moving.
  • Follow up persistently with outside providers when testing, records, or clearances are delayed, advocating for patients while maintaining professional communication.
  • Conduct or support standardized pre-operative patient calls and clearly walk patients through established non-clinical instructions and next steps.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient conversations, completed requirements, pending items, and case status within the appropriate systems.
  • Communicate surgical readiness, outstanding requirements, and potential delays clearly to the broader practice team.
  • Recognize clinical questions, unusual circumstances, or concerns that fall outside your administrative scope and escalate them promptly rather than providing independent medical advice.
  • Provide additional medical administrative and patient-coordination support when needed to improve the efficiency of the surgical process.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in medical administration, surgical coordination, patient coordination, pre-operative coordination, or closely related healthcare operations.
  • Hands-on experience working in a U.S. medical practice or healthcare environment.
  • Direct experience coordinating surgical or pre-operative patients, including appointments, tests, medical records, clearances, or required documentation.
  • Experience using EMR, CRM, patient-management, or comparable medical-office systems.
  • Confidence communicating directly with patients and contacting hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare providers.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with strong documentation, organization, case-tracking, and follow-through skills.
  • Sound judgment regarding administrative versus clinical responsibilities, including knowing when an issue must be escalated to clinical staff.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in plastic surgery, cosmetic surgery, aesthetics, or another high-touch private-pay medical environment.
  • Medical Assistant training, nursing-related education, healthcare education, or equivalent clinical-office experience.
  • Experience conducting standardized pre-operative patient calls.

About Crain Communications

Crain Communications is a premier global media organization delivering business news, analysis, and insights across industries. We are seeking a high-performing Account Executive to drive revenue growth for the Genomeweb brand. This role is responsible for developing and managing client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and delivering integrated marketing solutions across digital, events, and custom content.

The ideal candidate is a consultative seller with experience in B2B media, life sciences, healthcare, or complex solution sales, who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

- Experience selling into life sciences, healthcare or regulated industries is a plus

- Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

- Ability to manage complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders

- Self-motivated, results-driven, and highly collaborative

Preferred Experience

- Background in healthcare media, marketing, or SaaS

- Existing relationships within healthcare marketing or agency networks

- Experience with consultative / solution-based selling approaches

Why Join GenomeWeb?

Genomeweb is the most trusted voice in genomics, and molecular diagnostics business journalism. As part of our sales team, you’ll work with top-tier clients, shape impactful campaigns, and connect industry leaders with critical insights.

This role is based remote on the West Coast or in the NYC office.

Pay Transparency Disclosure:

The estimated base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $110,000 plus eligibility for a commission plan tied to revenue performance. On-target earnings (OTE) are expected to be approximately $200,000–$240,000 annually, with uncapped commission potential.

The final salary offering will consider a wide range of factors, including experience, accomplishments, and location. The salary range provided should not be considered as a salary limit or cap. In addition to base salary, Crain also offers competitive benefits including retirement plan savings contributions and bonus opportunities based on individual and company performance.

#sales

#full-time

@GenomeWeb

Brand Overview:

GenomeWeb is an independent online news organization based in New York. Since 1997, GenomeWeb has served the global community of scientists, technology professionals, and executives who use and develop the latest advanced tools in molecular biology research and molecular diagnostics.

GenomeWeb’s editorial mission is to cover the scientific and economic ecosystem spurred by the advent of high-throughput genome sequencing. We operate the largest online newsroom focused on advanced molecular research tools in order to provide our readers with exclusive news and in-depth analysis of this rapidly evolving market.

GenomeWeb users can be found in major scientific organizations around the world, including biopharmaceutical companies, research universities, biomedical institutes, clinical labs, and government laboratories. Our advertisers include leading suppliers of research tools, analytical instruments, information technology, and molecular diagnostics. GenomeWeb is a business unit of Crain Communications.

@GenomeWeb

About Crain Communications:

Crain Communications is a leading business news and information company with a portfolio of 24 media brands that provide indispensable coverage and data for professionals globally and across sectors, including advertising, automotive, finance, healthcare, staffing, and workforce solutions. Many of Crain’s brands are the most influential media properties in the industries and communities they serve, including Ad Age, Automotive News, Pensions & Investments, Modern Healthcare, Staffing Industry Analysts, as well as Crain’s regional business brands. For more than a century, our dedication to deep sector expertise and journalistic integrity has enabled us to provide trusted insights across all our platforms, empowering today’s business leaders to make industry-shaping decisions. To learn more about Crain Communications, visitcrain.com.

Environmental Demands

Where you work matters. The job posting will provide specific information on where and when your amazing work would be performed. Employee work location is determined by the needs of the specific team and may include on-site, hybrid or remote. Employee work location is subject to change.

  • An “in-office” role would require the employee to come into the office most days with occasional flexibility to work remotely if tasks can be performed elsewhere and if the manager approves.
  • A “remote” role would allow an employee to work from a home office that is in one of the states Crain does business in. We can only employ a remote / "work from home" employee if they reside in one of these states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MD, MA, MI, MN, NV, NY, NC, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, and Washington, DC.
  • A “hybrid” role would be a mix of in-office and remote work. There may be a specified schedule for coming into the office or it could be at the discretion of the employee with the manager’s approval, subject to change.
  • Employees who live within a reasonable commute distance from a Crain office are expected to work on-site 3 days per week.

Many positions will also include work donein “the field.” Depending on the role, this may include conducting in-person interviews, attending work-related events, meeting with sources or clients. Specifics will be noted in the job posting but are subject to change as a role evolves.  Employees may be exposed to adverse environmental conditions, specifically during field work. Other typical job functions are performed under conditions such as those found in general office work. 

Travel to cover news stories/events, meetings with clients, and to our geographically separated offices may be required.  It is the nature of many positions to experience non-standard working hours and be on-call when needed for responding to email, meeting with clients, attending work-related events, story development or breaking news. Most employees perform work Monday through Friday, although early-morning, evening or weekend shifts may be required.  Work schedule and travel requirements are subject to change as a role and needs evolve over time.

Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of many Crain jobs and are subject to change.

Physical activities will include frequent in-person or virtual interactions. For most positions, it is essential to be able to remain at a desk/computer workstation for prolonged periods, perform computer-related tasks, and create/maintain documents within filing systems.  Must have close visual acuity to perform an activity, such as preparing and analyzing reports and information, transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, or extensive reading.  The typical physical requirements are light work—exerting up to 25lbs of force occasionally and/or up to 10lbs of force frequently and may include climbing, pushing, standing, hearing, walking, reaching, grasping, kneeling, stooping, and repetitive motion.  Some positions will have additional physical requirements, including exerting up to 50lbs of force to move and/or carry equipment, supplies, files, or other materials as the role requires.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions and meet the environmental and physical demands of the role.

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)

The Senior Revenue Cycle Analyst (CA) reports to the Revenue Cycle Manager and supports regional revenue cycle operations for our California locations through advanced data analysis, denial trending, performance reporting, and targeted resolution of complex pre-bill edits.   • Present findings and strategic recommendations to leadership, translating complex analytics into clear operational direction.

  • Serve as subject matter expert for enterprise-wide revenue cycle improvement initiatives, driving data-informed process redesign and denial prevention strategies

raw.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and execution-focused Manager of Advanced Analytics to help shape and deliver our analytics strategy and roadmap. This role is hands-on and influential, focused on designing and implementing scalable data solutions, building advanced BI capabilities, and enabling actionable insights across risk adjustment, clinical operations, quality, compliance, and cost management.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with the ability to guide and mentor team members while collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders. You will partner with data analysts, data scientists, technology teams, and business leaders to design, implement, and optimize advanced analytics solutions that support internal and external clients. With over a million managed lives and terabytes of healthcare data generated, your contributions will be critical to driving data-driven decision making and improving patient outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to the design and execution of Astrana Health’s enterprise analytics roadmap aligned with growth and value-based care objectives.
  • Lead the development of scalable analytics solutions and BI dashboards using tools such as Databricks and Power BI.
  • Implement and maintain strong data governance and development practices to ensure data accuracy, compliance, and trust.
  • Build customized reports and dashboards tailored to functional and executive stakeholders.
  • Partner with business units like Risk Adjustment and Quality to identify analytical opportunities, translate business needs into technical solutions, and deliver insights with measurable impact.
  • Support standardization and optimization of reporting/analytics capabilities across teams.
  • Mentor analysts and engineers, fostering technical excellence and a collaborative team environment.
  • Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations while communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Promote best practices in analytics, data engineering, and BI development.
  • Lead and mentor a team of analytics professionals supporting HEDIS quality measurement and Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) analytics.
  • Own end-to-end execution of key deliverables: HEDIS measure calculation, gap-to-goal reporting, compliance rate optimization, and RAF accuracy analytics across multiple lines of business
  • Partner with business stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Quality Improvement, Finance) to translate requirements into scalable analytic solutions and drive actionable insights.
  • Establish QA protocols and ensure data integrity for all reporting deliverables.
  • Drive improvements to Star Ratings performance and risk score accuracy through advanced analytics and process optimization.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and IT to enhance data infrastructure, implement new measures, and resolve source data quality issues.
  • Conduct performance reviews and set development goals, to build team strength.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data science, analytics, statistics, or related field.
  • At least 6 years of experience in data analytics and engineering, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or mentorship role.
  • Expertise with modern data stacks including Databricks, SQL, Azure, Power BI, and Python.
  • Strong understanding of value-based care analytics, risk adjustment, quality analytics (HEDIS) utilization management, finance, and claims.
  • Experience working with healthcare datasets and measures such as HCC, HEDIS, and clinical analytics.
  • Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for clinical and operational teams.
  • Experience in managing quality improvement initiatives and member outreach programs to close care gaps.
  • Strong understanding of EHR, claims, and supplemental data integration for quality reporting.
  • Hands-on experience supporting HEDIS submissions, rate optimization, or NCQA-related analytics workflows
  • Experience in Medicare Risk Adjustment analytics, HCC/RAF gap analysis, encounter data, or revenue optimization programs
  • Demonstrated healthcare payer analytics leadership with clear examples of project ownership and measurable business impact
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, working across providers, payers, and internal teams.
  • Knowledge of SDLC best practices, including version control, testing, and CI/CD.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.
You're a great fit for this role if you:
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy leading teams to solve complex data challenges.
  • Are passionate about mentoring and growing the next generation of data engineering talent.
  • Have a bias for action and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions with measurable impact.
  • Bring a collaborative, team-first mindset to everything you do.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S.
  • The total compensation target pay range for this role is: $160,000 - $170,000. The salary range represents our national target range for this role.

Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Data Lead to help lead the strategy, governance, and quality of data on one of our large-scale federal data platform programs. In this role, you'll own execution of the data strategy for a multi-year enterprise data platform, lead the data supply chain, and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program that raises the bar for how data is documented, trusted, and reused across the platform. You'll govern how data is promoted from initial ingestion through validated, trusted status, set and maintain data quality standards, and serve as the connective tissue between the platform team and the many upstream source-system teams and business data owners who depend on it.

This is foundational work: the metadata and data quality practices you lead are what make it possible to safely expand governed self-service analytics and AI use cases. If you enjoy building durable data governance capability inside a live, high-stakes production environment — not just writing policy — we'd love to hear from you.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S., be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance, and obtain a U.S. Federal Government client badge. Bixal does not sponsor employment visas or assume sponsorship of existing employment visas.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own execution of the data strategy for a large-scale enterprise data platform, aligning day-to-day delivery with the organization’s broader data strategy and strategic goals.

  • Serve as the primary coordination point across multiple upstream source-system teams and business data owners, managing handoffs, ingestion readiness, and shared metadata standards across the ecosystem.

  • Lead the data supply chain — source onboarding, ingestion, and transformation — and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program, treating metadata as an operational capability rather than a one-time cataloging effort.

  • Govern the promotion of data through a tiered catalog architecture (e.g., raw, source, and trusted layers), defining clear admission criteria and applying the model consistently across teams.

  • Set and maintain data quality standards across the platform, including completeness, conformance, freshness against SLAs, and defect/rework tracking.

  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI/platform teams to ensure metadata and data quality are sufficient to support expanding self-service analytics and AI use cases.

  • Establish and track measures of data quality, metadata coverage, and promotion/certification cycle time, and use them to prioritize remediation work.

  • Communicate data strategy progress, risks, and dependencies to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership.

  • Participate in Agile/SAFe delivery cadences, including planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus at least 10 years of related experience.

  • Strong track record coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams and data owners in complex, multi-system environments.

  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading a data strategy for a large, multi-source enterprise data platform.

  • Experience designing and operating metadata governance or maturity programs, including cataloging, ownership models, and promotion/certification criteria.

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar) and metadata/catalog tooling (e.g., Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Microsoft Purview).

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Working knowledge of distributed data processing concepts and common data programming or query languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala), sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams on pipeline design and performance.

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for non-technical audiences, including client leadership.

  • Professional certification in a cloud or data platform (e.g., AWS, Databricks), data governance (e.g., DAMA CDMP), or Agile delivery (e.g., SAFe).

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in highly regulated federal data domains (e.g., healthcare, benefits, or financial data).

  • Familiarity with responsible AI governance and how metadata and data quality maturity gate the expansion of AI use cases.

  • Hands-on experience building, tuning, or troubleshooting data pipelines on a cloud lakehouse platform (e.g., Databricks or comparable).

  • Exposure to CI/CD, source control, and observability tooling as applied to data platform and pipeline operations.

  • Experience with data lineage and impact-analysis tooling.

  • Experience supporting or serving in a Key Personnel role on a federal contract.

  • Background in federal digital services delivery.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Esta é uma oportunidade baseada em projetos em uma plataforma de treinamento de IA. Sem horário fixo, sem compromisso além do que se encaixa na sua rotina. Gravou, ganhou.

Sobre a Função

Estamos procurando pessoas para gravar vídeos em primeira pessoa de atividades domésticas do dia a dia. Você fixa o smartphone na cabeça, segue sua rotina normalmente, e a câmera captura exatamente o que você vê. Esses vídeos ajudam a treinar sistemas de IA e robôs a entender como as pessoas interagem com objetos em ambientes reais. Você lava louça todos os dias? Passa o aspirador no tapete? Passeia com o cachorro? Dobra roupa? E se você pudesse ganhar dinheiro apenas gravando isso?

Responsabilidades

  • Gravar atividades domésticas do dia a dia em primeira pessoa — cozinhar, limpar, organizar, dobrar roupa, cuidar do jardim, passear com o cachorro, entre outras
  • Gravar em sua própria casa, quintal, garagem ou espaço de trabalho
  • Seguir orientações breves de gravação para cada sessão
  • Enviar os vídeos pelo aplicativo do projeto

Requisitos

  • Equipamento: Ter ou utilizar um smartphone ou outro dispositivo de câmera capaz de gravar a 30 FPS ou mais e resolução de 1080p ou superior. iPhone 12 ou mais recente, Google Pixel 6+ ou Samsung Galaxy S21+ (deve ter lente grande angular / 0.5x)
  • Método de captura: Fixar o dispositivo na altura da testa ou dos olhos para obter uma perspectiva egocêntrica, mantendo um ângulo levemente inclinado para baixo para maximizar a visibilidade das mãos
  • Software: Utilizar o aplicativo designado "D&A" para toda a captura e envio de dados
  • Controle de qualidade: Garantir que todas as filmagens estejam nítidas, estáveis, bem iluminadas, com pelo menos 15 segundos de duração, e que retratem tarefas úteis e intencionais, sem pausas desnecessárias ou movimentos forçados

Por que essa oportunidade freelance é perfeita para você?

• Ganhe dinheiro enquanto faz suas tarefas domésticas: até o equivalente a $6 por hora, dependendo do projeto

• Este é um trabalho freelance baseado em projetos — escolha as sessões de gravação de acordo com sua disponibilidade

• Influencie o futuro de como a IA e os robôs entendem e interagem com o mundo real

raw.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.
