raw.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

As a Cardiology, Field Medical Director you will be a key member of the utilization management team. We can offer you a meaningful way to make a difference in patients lives, in a non-clinical environment. You can enjoy better work- life balance on a team that values collaboration and continuous learning while providing better health outcomes.

Collaboration Opportunities:

  • Routinely interacts with leadership and management staff, other Physicians, and staff whenever a physician`s input is needed or required. As well as, aids and acts as a resource to Initial Clinical Reviewers.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Serve as the specialty match reviewer in Cardiology cases, that do not initially meet the applicable medical necessity guidelines, as well as other requests when providers, clients, or state laws require specialty reviews to be completed by the subject matter expert.

  • Provides clinical rationale for standard and expedited appeals.

  • Discusses determinations (peer to peer phone calls) with requesting physicians or ordering providers, when available, within the regulatory timeframe of the request.

  • Utilizes medical/clinical review guidelines and parameters to assure consistency in the MD review process to reflect appropriate utilization and compliance with SBU`s policies/procedures, as well as Utilization Review Accreditation Commission (URAC) and National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) guidelines.

  • Ensures documentation of all communications with medical office staff and/or MD provider is recorded in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Participates in on-going training per inter-rater reliability process.

  • May assist the Senior Medical Director in research activities/questions related to the Utilization Management process, interpretation, guidelines and/or system support.

  • On a requested basis, may function as Medical Director for selecting health plans or regions, assuming overall accountability for utilization management while working in conjunction with the Senior Medical Director.

Qualifications - Required and Preferred:

  • MD/DO/MBBS Degree

  • Current, unrestricted clinical license in medicine or required specialty

  • Obtaining and maintaining medical licenses in the state you reside, as well as, other state licensure required per business needs

  • Active Board Certification in Cardiology, Vascular Surgery or Adult Congenital Heart Disease

  • Strong clinical, management, communication, and organizational skills

  • Energetic and curious with a passion for quality and value in health care

  • Computer Proficiency

  • Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in the practice of Cardiology is preferred

  • Not under current exclusion or sanction by any state or federal health care program, including Medicare or Medicaid, and is not identified as an “excluded person” by the Office of Inspector General of the Department of Health and Human Services or the General Service Administration (GSA), or reprimanded or sanctioned by Medicare.

  • No history of a major disciplinary or legal action by a state medical board

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Technical Requirements:

We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact for further assistance.

The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $120-$135/hr. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

Job Description

What to Expect When You Apply:

We look forward to learning more about your experience! Here is a quick overview of what to expect after clicking "Apply":

  • Estimated Time: 5–7 minutes to complete.

  • Information Needed: Basic contact details, education level, and an up-to-date resume or work history details.

  • Accuracy Notice: Please ensure all resume and employment information is complete and accurate, as background and employment details will be verified during the selection process.

  • Workday Account (Optional): We encourage creating a Workday candidate account to track your application status, though it is not required to apply.

  • Next Steps & Hiring Roadmap: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your submission. The hiring process typically includes 2–3 interview rounds and a required Spanish bilingual language assessment prior to hire.

A bit about this role:

As a Bilingual Member Flex Guide at Devoted Health, you are a primary bridge for our English- and Spanish-speaking members. You will meet members where they are, eliminate language barriers, and help them navigate the complexities of healthcare with deep empathy, cultural awareness, and precision.

Guides operate across inbound service, proactive outreach, real-time digital support, and clinical administration. You will seamlessly flex across workflows—shifting from answering benefit questions in Spanish to conducting proactive clinical outreach in English—as seasonal or business needs evolve. In every interaction, you bring our mission to life by treating every member like family while utilizing our AI Guide Assistant to deliver accurate, real-time care.

You may be hired into one of the following job profiles: Inbound Member Service Guide, Outbound Member Service Guide, Care Access Guide, Digital Guide, Pharmacy Guide, or Member Outreach Specialist

Responsibilities and Impact will Include:

Bilingual Member Engagement & Support

  • Engage fluently in English and Spanish across all communication channels, including inbound/outbound calls, SMS, chat, secure messaging, email, and video.

  • Translate and simplify complex healthcare, insurance, and medical terms into clear, culturally sensitive, and actionable guidance.

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact: listen actively to member needs, build rapport, and assist them in finding language-congruent providers and scheduling appointments.

  • Conduct proactive outreach in the member's preferred language to share information on preventive screenings, clinical programs, and benefit utilization.

  • Identify situations requiring clinical escalation and collaborate with medical staff and bilingual teammates to ensure continuous care.

Operational Excellence

  • Partner with an AI Guide Assistant in real time to access complex benefit information quickly and deliver accurate answers in both languages.

  • Maintain complete, accurate documentation in internal systems for every interaction without exception.

  • Strictly adhere to HIPAA, regulatory compliance guidelines, and privacy policies to safeguard member trust.

  • Consistently meet productivity and quality standards, including resolution rates, service quality metrics, and handle times.

Flexibility & Growth

  • Flex fluidly between inbound support, outbound campaigns, and cross-functional programs based on seasonal business demands.

  • Adapt quickly to changing workflows, technology platforms, and policy updates with a positive, solutions-oriented attitude.

  • Actively incorporate real-time coaching and feedback from leadership to drive continuous professional development.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Bilingual Proficiency: Professional, native-level oral and written fluency in both English and Spanish is required.

  • Customer Experience: 1+ years of experience in a high-volume customer-facing role, contact center, or fast-paced healthcare environment.

  • Cultural Competency & Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with a natural ability to connect authentically across diverse communities and de-escalate sensitive situations.

  • Complex Problem-Solving: Ability to break down intricate insurance and medical concepts into clear terms in both languages.

  • Tech Adaptability: Comfort working alongside AI-powered tools and navigating multiple software platforms simultaneously while talking, typing, and translating.

  • Agility: Demonstrated ability to pivot between shifting priorities and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.

  • Schedule Flexibility: Willingness to work variable hours based on operational needs and seasonal demand.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Background in Medicare Advantage, health insurance, or HIPAA-regulated medical environments.

  • Prior experience in a dedicated bilingual customer service or medical translation role.

  • Proven stress-management techniques for maintaining composure in fast-paced or emotionally demanding settings.

Operational Hours & Scheduling Schedules are finalized during the offer process. Shifts are 8.5 hours (including a 30-minute unpaid lunch break) within the coverage windows below. Most shifts fall within standard daytime and early evening hours, with limited late-night shifts assigned based on call volume.

  • April – September: Monday – Friday (8:00 AM – 2:00 AM ET) · Saturday (8:00 AM – 11:00 PM ET)

  • October – November: Sunday – Saturday (8:00 AM – 2:00 AM ET)

  • November – March: Sunday – Saturday (8:00 AM – 1:00 AM ET)

Salary Range:$20 – $25/ hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com 2.800 consultores e especialistas presentes em 28 países, construído sobre uma única convicção: a IA não transforma os negócios. A inteligência arquitetada, sim. A IA não substitui as pessoas. Ela nos reposiciona para um lugar que nenhum sistema pode alcançar: compreender, decidir, projetar e criar. Na Keyrus, você não vai apenas desenvolver habilidades — você vai desenvolver discernimento. Sua expertise se aprimora a cada desafio de cliente que você resolve, cada oportunidade que você constrói e cada parceria estratégica que você ajuda a formar.

Com o tempo, você se torna um dos profissionais mais raros da era da inteligência: alguém que conecta estratégia de negócios, dados, IA e tomada de decisão executiva em grande escala. Este não é um cargo que você ocupa. É uma disciplina que você domina e uma história que você ajuda a escrever para se tornar um Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

A tecnologia amplifica. A cultura Keyrus diferencia. A disciplina industrial conecta as duas.

🚀 O que Você Vai Arquitetar

raw.excerpt: Bring more to life. At Danaher, our work saves lives.
raw.description:
Bring more to life.

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact — innovating at the speed of life.

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we're committed to hiring and developing from within. You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

About the Diagnostics Platform

The Diagnostics Platform is one of Danaher's three global platforms, uniting a portfolio of leading operating companies whose work sits at the point of clinical decision — from the emergency room and intensive care unit to the pathology lab, the core hospital laboratory, the molecular diagnostics workstation, and the patient bedside. The technologies developed and delivered by these operating companies help clinicians detect cancer earlier, identify and manage infectious diseases ranging from tuberculosis and HIV to sepsis and respiratory infections, monitor critically ill and vulnerable patients continuously, and make faster, more confident decisions when time and accuracy save lives.

The platform has a global presence, with operating companies serving hospitals, clinical laboratories, and point-of-care settings on six continents. Its products are highly regulated connected medical devices and in vitro diagnostics (IVD) directly involved in acute-care and life-critical clinical decisions — making cybersecurity a patient-safety, regulatory, and brand-trust priority for the platform.

The Platform Information Security Officer (PISO), Diagnostics Platform is responsible for end-to-end cybersecurity execution across all operating companies (OpCos) within the Diagnostics Platform globally. As part of Danaher's global information security operating model — six central DIS Global Services pillars and identically structured DIS Platform Security Teams under each platform — this leader is the platform's senior-most cybersecurity executive and the operational counterpart to the Global CISO across a global conglomerate of OpCos.

The PISO enforces enterprise cyber standards across the Diagnostics OpCos, drives continuous improvement, and adapts the global program to the unique security needs of each OpCo's connected medical devices, clinical customers, regulatory obligations (including FDA premarket and postmarket medical device cybersecurity, EU IVDR, and IEC 81001-5-1 / IEC 62443), and manufacturing footprint.

This position reports to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and is part of the Global Information Security organization, located in Washington, D.C. and will be a remote role, with regular global travel required to Diagnostics OpCo sites.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Own end-to-end cybersecurity execution across all Diagnostics OpCos globally, translating Danaher's global cyber strategy, policies, and standards into measurable outcomes while serving as the platform's senior cybersecurity executive and single accountable face of cyber to OpCo Presidents, CIOs, R&D/product leaders, manufacturing site leaders, the CISO, and OpCo executive leadership.

  • Build, lead, and develop a globally distributed Platform Security Team spanning Security Architecture & Engineering, Technical Security Risk Management, Cyber Assurance Management, Data & AI Security, Cyber PMO, and Manufacturing Security, partnering in a matrixed model with the six DIS Global Services pillars to align platform execution to enterprise standards and central capabilities.

  • Own the Diagnostics Platform's cyber risk register, technical risk management, vulnerability management prioritization, remediation delivery, architecture review execution, integration and remediation engineering, and platform architecture standards that embed enterprise controls into OpCo enterprise systems, cloud environments, and connected medical device platforms.

  • Lead platform cyber assurance, including customer security questionnaires, audit response, ISO 27001, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other cybersecurity certification programs, serving as the single face to hospital, health system, and government-agency assessors.

  • Coordinate with the central Product Security function on FDA premarket cybersecurity, postmarket vulnerability management, SBOM, and PSIRT operations for Diagnostics OpCos' connected medical devices and IVD instruments, including requirements under Section 524B of the FD&C Act and other applicable regulatory expectations.

  • Drive cyber diligence, integration, and day-1 through steady-state onboarding when Diagnostics OpCos acquire new business units, while leading data protection, AI security governance coordination, application security engineering, secrets management, and MFA coordination across OpCo applications and clinical data estates in alignment with HIPAA, GDPR, China PIPL, and other applicable data protection regimes.

  • Secure the platform's OT and manufacturing plant environments across global manufacturing sites in coordination with the central OT/manufacturing security function, including plant engagement, site-level operations, and OT segmentation using IEC 62443 or NIST 800-82; run the platform cyber PMO across multiple time zones, including cadence, RAG reporting, resource loading, initiative execution, KPI/posture reporting, and application of the Danaher Business System to drive continuous improvement, standard work, and problem solving.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, with 12+ years of information security experience including direct ownership of a cybersecurity function serving multiple business units, sites, or operating companies within a global organization.

  • Demonstrated experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, Business Unit or Divisional CISO, or equivalent senior cyber leader accountable for an end-to-end program spanning security architecture, risk management, assurance, application/data security, and coordination with SOC and incident response.

  • Experience leading an information security function through multiple layers of management across globally distributed teams and time zones.

  • Experience operating in a decentralized, multi-business-unit environment, including influencing without direct authority, balancing enterprise standards with operating-company autonomy, and driving execution through matrixed relationships.

  • Experience owning cybersecurity certification and audit programs, including ISO 27001, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or equivalent, and leading customer security questionnaire and third-party assurance response at scale.

  • Experience partnering on product security for connected medical devices, IVD instruments, or other regulated hardware, including FDA premarket and postmarket medical device cybersecurity requirements, as well as running a cybersecurity program across multiple countries and data-protection regimes such as HIPAA, GDPR, China PIPL, or equivalent.

  • Experience with cyber diligence and post-close integration for mergers and acquisitions.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 25-30% of the time, including international travel to Diagnostics operating company sites.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Cybersecurity leadership within medical devices, IVD, diagnostics, life sciences, or an equivalent regulated, patient-facing industry.

  • Deep familiarity with FDA Section 524B, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62443-4-1/4-2, and EU IVDR / MDR cybersecurity expectations.

  • AI security governance, including secure use of AI-assisted development tools, LLM application security, and data governance for AI workloads that touch clinical or patient data.

Danaher offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it's a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

The annual salary range for this role is $225,000-$275,000. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Department & Team: Facilities & Real Estate
Reports to: Director, Global Workplace
Location: New York, NY preferred; Virtual US / East Coast Time Zone

Role Overview

The Technical Facilities and Project Manager is a key member of the Global Facilities and Real Estate team responsible for delivering and continuously improving Genesys workplaces globally. The role combines project leadership with technical facilities expertise to ensure offices are well designed, efficiently operated, sustainable, secure, and aligned with consistent standards. It leads complex design, construction, renovation, and infrastructure initiatives while developing scalable solutions across building systems, energy and sustainability, physical security, occupancy, and facilities operations.

Supporting a portfolio of more than 40 locations, this role translates global workplace strategy into repeatable, sound solutions while adapting to local requirements. Reporting to the Director, Global Workplace, the position partners with regional facilities teams, business leaders, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, landlords, vendors, sustainability and security teams, and other senior stakeholders.

This role provides meaningful visibility across global workplace initiatives and the opportunity to influence how Genesys facilities evolve as the portfolio and workplace needs change. Through close partnership across regions and functions, the role helps create reliable, sustainable, and effective workplaces that support employees and the broader business.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead multiple concurrent workplace design, construction, renovation, infrastructure, and facilities improvement projects from planning and due diligence through design, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.

  • Act as an owner-focused project lead, protecting Genesys interests and balancing business objectives, employee experience, technical performance, cost, schedule, quality, risk, and long-term operational value.

  • Develop and manage scopes, schedules, budgets, forecasts, procurement plans, change controls, risk registers, governance, reporting, and escalation paths; identify issues early and drive corrective action.

  • Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders across regions and time zones, and support site selection and technical due diligence.

  • Lead operational readiness and turnover, including commissioning, punch-list completion, asset documentation, training, O&M manuals, warranties, and transition to facilities operations.

Technical Facilities Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership across HVAC, electrical, lighting, controls, plumbing, life safety, building automation, metering, and related workplace infrastructure.

  • Assess existing facilities and system performance, risks, deficiencies, lifecycle needs, and improvement opportunities; read and review architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Evaluate designs for functionality, constructability, maintainability, regulatory compliance, sustainability, reliability, lifecycle cost, energy performance, and employee experience; participate in design reviews, value engineering, commissioning, and technical problem solving.

  • Translate workplace strategies into specifications, standards, workflows, and repeatable implementation guidelines, using lessons learned to continuously improve global practices.

Global Standards, Workplace Integration & Data

  • Develop and maintain global technical standards, design criteria, specifications, checklists, templates, and performance requirements for facilities, building systems, sustainability, security integration, and project delivery.

  • Partner with regional teams to apply global standards while addressing local codes, regulations, landlord requirements, climate, operations, and cultural needs; ensure project decisions transition effectively into ongoing operations.

  • Establish measurable requirements and verify completed projects perform as intended; support occupancy measurement, space performance, facilities analytics, and clear technical documentation that strengthens portfolio consistency and institutional knowledge.

Sustainability, Energy & Environmental Compliance

  • Embed sustainable design and operating practices into projects and facilities, supporting Genesys environmental objectives and alignment with ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems.

  • Advance energy efficiency, water conservation, responsible materials, waste reduction, indoor environmental quality, carbon reduction, and high-performance building practices; identify opportunities in HVAC, controls, metering, lighting, equipment, operations, and green-energy procurement.

  • Partner with stakeholders to measure, validate, track, and report energy, water, waste, and related environmental performance, and support applicable regional requirements such as CSRD, EED, and evolving sustainability frameworks.

  • Support LEED strategies for interior fit-outs and ongoing operations, and use post-implementation data to identify further efficiency and performance improvements.

Physical Security & Life Safety Integration

  • Partner with Corporate Security and other stakeholders to assess and integrate physical security and life-safety requirements into projects and existing facilities, including access control, surveillance, visitor management, intrusion detection, and related technologies.

  • Ensure security requirements are addressed early and coordinated with architectural, engineering, IT, facilities, and building infrastructure.

Financial, Procurement & Risk Management

  • Prepare and maintain project budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, cost reports, and variance analyses; evaluate proposals, bids, estimates, change orders, and contractor recommendations for cost, quality, and value.

  • Partner with Procurement and Legal on sourcing, selection, contract administration, and vendor negotiations; monitor external partner performance and hold consultants and contractors accountable for commitments and outcomes.

  • Identify technical, financial, schedule, operational, compliance, and delivery risks; develop mitigation strategies and business cases that clearly present costs, benefits, alternatives, and long-term implications.

Stakeholder Leadership & Communication

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and primary project contact for regional teams, business leaders, and senior stakeholders, translating complex topics into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Facilitate project meetings, design reviews, workshops, executive updates, and decision-making sessions, with clear visibility into status, risks, decisions, budget, and schedule.

  • Build effective relationships across a geographically distributed organization and navigate competing priorities while maintaining focus on successful project outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • 10+ years of experience in facilities, design, engineering, construction, or project management, including significant responsibility for complex commercial workplace projects and multiple concurrent, multi-phase initiatives.

  • Strong working knowledge of commercial building systems, construction methods, project controls, facilities operations, and the ability to read architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and technical documentation.

  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets, schedules, forecasts, procurement, risks, change controls, commissioning, and operational turnover.

  • Working knowledge of environmental management and sustainability practices, including ISO 14001, energy management, high-performance building principles, building codes, workplace safety, accessibility, and regulatory compliance.

  • Excellent organization, problem solving, decision-making, written and verbal communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to work independently and collaboratively in a global, remote-working environment.

  • Ability to periodically participate in meetings outside normal business hours for international collaboration and to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require, generally not expected to exceed 20%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving as an Owner’s Representative for corporate workplace, commercial interiors, or facilities projects and/or managing global or multi-regional project portfolios.

  • Professional certification or licensure such as PMP, LEED AP, PE, RA, CFM, or equivalent.

  • Experience with LEED ID+C or O+M, ESG initiatives, energy-management programs, environmental or energy reporting requirements, commissioning, building automation, metering, facilities analytics, or asset lifecycle planning.

  • Familiarity with BIM, AutoCAD, facilities-management and project-management platforms, reporting dashboards, and related digital tools.

  • Experience developing global technical standards, specifications, playbooks, or design guidelines for a corporate real estate portfolio.

  • Strong global perspective and commitment to continuous improvement, sustainability, resilience, accessibility, safety, workplace excellence, and employee experience

$104,000.00 - $183,000.00

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job
  • The ability to communicate clearly, acknowledge mistakes, and disagree when necessary
  • Demonstrable passion for offensive security
  • Experience reading, writing and debugging C++ and Python code
  • Basic experience with memory exploitation techniques
  • Demonstrable experience with web exploitation techniques and tools (e.g. PortSwigger lab scoreboards)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

Job Post: Patient Outreach Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

Work Days: Monday – Friday

Salary: $5 - $6 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Our client is a well-established U.S.-based prosthetics and orthotics healthcare provider with approximately 30 clinic locations. We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and proactive Patient Outreach Specialist to join the remote scheduling and patient access team.

In this patient-facing role, you will help patients move efficiently from an initial inquiry, referral, or prescription to a scheduled appointment at the appropriate clinic. You will communicate with patients through phone, email, chat, and text while coordinating with physician offices and internal healthcare teams to ensure required information and documentation are complete.

This position is ideal for someone who combines excellent patient communicationwith strong organization and follow-through. You should be comfortable making outbound calls, guiding patients through next steps, handling objections or concerns professionally, and managing multiple patient cases in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Above all, you will help create a positive patient experience by making the scheduling process as clear, efficient, and supportive as possible.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Outreach & Communication

  • Handle inbound and outbound patient inquiries through phone, email, chat, and text
  • Communicate with patients professionally, empathetically, and in accordance with HIPAA requirements
  • Promptly contact patients following an inquiry, referral, or prescription
  • Gather required demographic, insurance, referral, prescription, and relevant clinical information
  • Assess patient needs using established product, service, and scheduling guidelines
  • Clearly explain scheduling requirements, next steps, and expectations
  • Address questions and concerns while helping patients understand what is needed to proceed
  • Follow up consistently with patients who have incomplete information or outstanding requirements
  • Maintain professionalism when communicating with upset, hesitant, or difficult-to-reach patients
  • Send approved patient reminders, updates, newsletters, or other communications as needed

Patient Scheduling & Access Coordination

  • Schedule patients for prosthetic and orthotic appointments at the appropriate clinic
  • Determine the appropriate scheduling location based on patient needs, location, device type, documentation status, and provider availability
  • Support patient-facing scheduling and calendar coordination
  • Ensure required information and documentation are received and reviewed before scheduling
  • Coordinate with patients, physician offices, intake, billing, clinic teams, and other support departments to resolve barriers to care
  • Escalate difficult patient concerns, incomplete documentation, unreachable patients, or workflow barriers to the appropriate supervisor or department
  • Help ensure each patient interaction ends with a clear and appropriate next step

Documentation & Follow-Up

  • Review and confirm required documentation, including prescriptions, insurance information, physician details, referrals, and other necessary records
  • Accurately enter and maintain patient information in applicable systems
  • Document all patient interactions, outreach attempts, appointment details, and follow-up actions
  • Sort, prioritize, and respond to patient emails, text messages, and other communications in a timely manner
  • Maintain organized follow-up workflows for multiple patient cases
  • Protect patient confidentiality and ensure all documentation and communication meet HIPAA standards
  • Take ownership of assigned patient interactions through the appropriate next step or escalation

Additional Support

  • Collaborate with intake, billing, clinic operations, support teams, and leadership
  • Participate in virtual training, coaching sessions, team meetings, and remote huddles
  • Assist with internal calendar coordination when needed
  • Participate in community outreach events or virtual health education sessions when requested

What Success Looks Like

A successful Patient Outreach Specialist delivers an exceptional patient experience while helping patients get scheduled quickly, accurately, and compassionately.

Success in this position includes:

  • Timely and consistent patient outreach
  • Accurate and complete documentation
  • Strong follow-up and ownership of patient cases
  • Efficient and accurate appointment scheduling
  • Clear, compassionate, and professional communication
  • Effective coordination with internal teams and physician offices
  • Proper escalation of barriers or incomplete requirements
  • Consistent adherence to HIPAA and confidentiality standards
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in healthcare, patient scheduling, patient access, customer service, call center operations, sales, or another patient-facing role
  • Experience handling inbound and/or outbound calls
  • Comfortable conducting proactive patient outreach and following established scripts or workflows
  • Ability to professionally address questions, concerns, and objections while guiding patients toward an appropriate next step
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong listening skills and ability to understand patient needs, concerns, urgency, and scheduling barriers
  • Compassionate, patient, and professional communication style
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple patient cases, communications, follow-ups, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and metrics-driven environment
  • Strong follow-through and ownership of assigned patient interactions
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with intake, billing, clinic operations, physician offices, support teams, and leadership
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and commitment to protecting confidential patient information
  • Positive and resilient attitude when handling rejection, upset patients, incomplete information, or unsuccessful outreach attempts

Preferred Experience

  • 1–3 years of relevant patient-facing or healthcare experience
  • Previous experience with prosthetics and orthotics
  • Durable Medical Equipment (DME) experience
  • Medical scheduling or patient access experience
  • Referral and prescription coordination experience
  • Experience verifying or collecting insurance information
  • Experience communicating with physician offices
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms
  • Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems
  • Experience with VoIP or healthcare phone systems
  • Experience with chat or text-based patient communication platforms
  • Experience working with a U.S.-based healthcare organization

Basic requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English
  • Must have relevant healthcare, administrative, customer service, or patient-facing work experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required
  • Must be comfortable participating in virtual training, coaching sessions, and remote team huddles
  • Must maintain HIPAA-compliant work practices and patient confidentiality at all times
  • Must not have concurrent employment during scheduled working hours
  • Must be available for the required 40-hour workweek

Technical Requirements

  • Device: Reliable laptop or desktop computer
  • Internet: High-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps)
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset
  • Video: Webcam for virtual meetings
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview

The Senior Advertising Supervision Principal will review and approve marketing material requests from Financial Advisors and home office employees.

Responsibilities

raw.description:
Customer Success & Client Retention Specialist – Remote | Part-Time

Position Type: Part-Time, Remote
Schedule: Less than 30 hours/week
Location: Remote — Open Worldwide

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success & Client Retention Specialist to strengthen client relationships, improve the customer experience, and reduce churn.

This role is focused on what happens after a client comes onboard — making sure customers see value, stay engaged, receive proactive support, and have compelling reasons to continue the relationship.

You’ll work closely with leadership, sales, and operations to improve the customer journey from onboarding through long-term retention.

If you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Retention, or Customer Experience and enjoy building lasting client relationships, this could be a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Success & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Conduct proactive client check-ins and follow-ups
  • Understand client goals, concerns, and expectations
  • Identify potential issues before they become reasons for churn
  • Ensure clients consistently receive a responsive and professional experience

Client Retention & Churn Reduction

  • Develop and execute strategies to improve client retention
  • Identify customers who may be disengaged or at risk of leaving
  • Investigate the reasons behind churn and dissatisfaction
  • Create proactive outreach and re-engagement strategies
  • Recommend improvements that increase customer loyalty and long-term value
  • Support renewal conversations where applicable

Customer Journey Optimization

  • Review the full customer journey from onboarding through ongoing engagement
  • Identify friction points, communication gaps, and opportunities for improvement
  • Help create a more consistent and engaging client experience
  • Work with internal teams to implement customer experience improvements
  • Ensure onboarding sets clear expectations and positions clients for long-term success

Customer Feedback & Insights

  • Gather customer feedback through:
    • Client conversations
    • Surveys
    • NPS
    • CSAT
    • Ongoing account interactions
  • Identify patterns and recurring client concerns
  • Translate feedback into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Share customer insights with leadership and relevant teams

Customer Success Metrics & Reporting

Monitor and report on metrics such as:

  • Client retention rate
  • Customer churn
  • NPS
  • CSAT
  • Customer engagement
  • Renewal performance

Use customer data and feedback to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with sales, operations, and leadership teams
  • Communicate customer needs and recurring pain points internally
  • Help improve handoffs between sales, onboarding, and ongoing customer support
  • Support initiatives designed to improve retention and customer lifetime value

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Naturally build trust and strong client relationships
  • Are proactive rather than waiting for customers to complain
  • Understand why customers churn and how to reduce it
  • Communicate confidently and professionally
  • Balance empathy with business objectives
  • Are comfortable working with customer data and performance metrics
  • Can turn customer feedback into actionable improvements
  • Are organized and capable of working independently

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in:
    • Customer Success
    • Account Management
    • Client Retention
    • or a closely related client-facing role
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Customer lifecycle management
    • Client engagement
    • Retention strategies
    • Churn reduction
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • or similar systems
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret customer feedback and performance metrics
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection and availability within the agreed part-time schedule

Nice to Have

  • Experience in:
    • Real estate
    • SaaS
    • Service-based businesses
  • Familiarity with Customer Success platforms such as:
    • Gainsight
    • ChurnZero
    • Intercom
  • Experience managing:
    • Renewals
    • Upselling
    • Cross-selling
    • At-risk accounts
  • Familiarity with NPS, CSAT, churn, and retention reporting

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing client health and engagement
  • Reaching out proactively to existing customers
  • Following up with clients who may be at risk of churning
  • Supporting onboarding and early customer engagement
  • Gathering and analyzing client feedback
  • Reviewing retention, NPS, and CSAT trends
  • Coordinating with sales and operations on customer issues
  • Identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey
  • Preparing retention insights and recommendations for leadership

In short: you make sure clients feel supported, see continued value, and want to stay.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved customer retention
  • Reduced client churn
  • Strong NPS and CSAT scores
  • Consistent client engagement and follow-up
  • Successful onboarding and early-stage adoption
  • Improved customer experience across the lifecycle
  • Clear identification and recovery of at-risk clients
  • Actionable customer feedback delivered to leadership

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote and open worldwide
  • Flexible part-time schedule
  • Direct impact on customer retention and business growth
  • Opportunity to shape the customer journey and retention strategy
  • Close collaboration with leadership
  • Long-term growth potential as the company scales

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After applying, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to complete a short Intro Video. This self-recorded video helps the hiring team learn more about your experience and communication before the client interview.

You can complete it on your own time and re-record your responses before submitting if needed.

Please check both your inbox and spam/junk folder for the Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Retention
  • Know how to build strong client relationships
  • Enjoy identifying and preventing churn
  • Are comfortable using customer data and feedback to improve retention
  • Want a flexible, part-time remote opportunity

We’d love to hear from you.

raw.title: Freight Pricing Analyst
raw.excerpt: Charger Logistics is a world class asset-based carrier.
raw.description:
Charger Logistics is a world class asset-based carrier. We specialize in delivering assets, on time and on budget. With the diverse fleet of equipment, we can handle a range of freight, including dedicated loads, specialized hauls, temperature-controlled goods and HAZMAT cargo.

Dispatchers and load planners encouraged to apply — if you've been quoting and negotiating rates on your own loads, you already do half this job

Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies. We are currently expanding and looking to add a motivated individual to our team. The Contract Pricing Analyst is responsible for developing, analyzing, and maintaining pricing structures for customer and carrier contracts. This role bridges sales, carrier sourcing, and finance by ensuring pricing accuracy, competitiveness, and profitability across long-term freight agreements, while supporting negotiation strategy with data-driven insight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain contract rate structures for customer freight agreements, including base rates, fuel surcharges, accessorials, and lane-specific pricing
  • Analyze historical freight data, market rate trends, and carrier costs to recommend competitive and profitable pricing
  • Partner with Sales and Carrier Sourcing teams to build pricing proposals for RFPs (Requests for Proposal) and bid responses
  • Model margin impact of proposed contract terms and flag deals falling outside target profitability thresholds
  • Monitor contract compliance — ensuring invoiced rates match agreed contract terms — and resolve pricing discrepancies
  • Track lane-level and account-level profitability over the life of a contract, recommending renegotiation when margins erode
  • Maintain pricing databases/tools (TMS, Excel models, or pricing software) with up-to-date rate cards
  • Conduct market benchmarking (e.g., DAT, Freightwaves SONAR) to validate pricing against spot and contract market conditions
  • Support renewal cycles by analyzing contract performance and preparing renewal/renegotiation recommendations
  • Collaborate with Legal/HR/Finance on contract terms that carry pricing implications (fuel escalators, minimum volume commitments, accessorial schedules)

Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
    • 2-3 years of experience in Dispatch, pricing, revenue management, or analytics — freight/logistics/3PL experience strongly preferred
    • Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, modeling); SQL or BI tool experience (Power BI/Tableau) an asset
    • Familiarity with TMS platforms (McLeod, Trimble, MercuryGate, etc.) and freight market data sources (DAT, SONAR)
    • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with high attention to detail
    • Ability to translate data into clear pricing recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
    • Strong communication skills to support cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Carrier Sourcing, and Finance

Benefits

  • Competitive Pay
  • Career Growth

raw.description:
Sr Manager Sales | Retail

The Sr Manager, Sales leads an enterprise software sales team responsible for growing revenue, retaining customers, and expanding adoption across a large installed customer base in North America. This role sets the team’s commercial direction, translates business trends and customer insight into territory strategy, and builds a repeatable operating rhythm for account planning, pipeline creation, forecasting, renewals, migrations, and expansion. The Sr Manager is accountable for an annual team quota and develops a high-performing team through coaching, clear performance expectations, talent development, and close partnership with Customer Success, Services, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a sales team to achieve the annual operating plan, team quota, customer retention goals, and assigned performance indicators.

  • Build and execute an install-base growth strategy that increases customer value through renewals, cross-sell, upsell, product adoption, migrations, and expansion into additional business units or subsidiaries.

  • Own territory and account planning, including segmentation, whitespace analysis, executive engagement plans, opportunity prioritization, and coordinated action plans for at-risk customers.

  • Establish a disciplined operating cadence for pipeline reviews, business reviews, forecast calls, deal strategy, and inspection of customer satisfaction, attrition, adoption, and migration metrics.

  • Generate accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts; assess risk and upside, communicate assumptions clearly, and make timely adjustments to coverage, resources, and priorities.

  • Coach direct reports through complex enterprise sales cycles, negotiations, pricing and concession decisions, executive presentations, escalations, and multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Services, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Revenue Operations to remove barriers, improve the customer experience, and maximize recurring revenue.

  • Hire, onboard, and manage talent; set expectations, conduct performance management, support development plans, and build a succession-ready team culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Manage assigned budget responsibilities and ensure sales programs, customer engagements, and operational plans are executed effectively within company policies and available resources.

What you will likely bring:

  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise software and SaaS sales, including recurring-revenue economics, customer lifecycle management, install-base expansion, renewals, migrations, and adoption-led growth. Specially in the retail industry

  • Strong strategic and commercial judgment; able to translate customer needs, market trends, competitive intelligence, and business data into actionable account and territory plans.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex negotiations involving pricing, concessions, terms and conditions, procurement, legal, security, finance, and executive stakeholders.

  • Proficient in sales forecasting, CRM discipline, pipeline analytics, quota and KPI management, and using data to diagnose performance and allocate resources.

  • Effective people leadership, executive communication, presentation, conflict resolution, and cross-functional influence skills; able to operate with ownership and agility in a changing environment.

What will set you apart:

  • 10+ years of progressive sales experience with demonstrated success in the software industry; SaaS experience required.

  • 5+ years of experience managing and developing sales employees, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team operating cadence.

  • Experience leading an annual sales or bookings quota of at least $2M in a high-volume business; typical scope for this role is approximately $5M in SaaS bookings.

  • 4+ years of specialized experience selling enterprise software to large, complex customers, with a track record of retention, expansion, and executive relationship management.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time within North America.

  • Preferred: experience with enterprise resource planning, business applications, or other mission-critical software; experience leading teams through cloud migrations, modernization, or major customer transformation programs.

  • Ideal candidates have Epicor experience in Eagle or Propello

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

  • Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.

  • Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.

  • Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.

  • Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.

  • Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.

  • Global Mobility:Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement 

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer. 

Range:

Minimum: $120,000 USD Maximum: $204,000 USD

The salary range provided reflects the national average for this job title and does not represent compensation specific to Epicor Software Corporation. Actual compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and market factors relevant to the position.

Recruiter (Talent Acquisition & Full-Cycle Recruiting) – Remote

Company: Pavago
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Overlap Preferred)

About the Role

Pavago is hiring a Recruiter to source, screen, and deliver top remote talent across Sales, Operations, Marketing, Customer Support, Executive Assistance, Finance, and Technology.

This is a fast-paced, full-cycle recruiting role where you’ll manage multiple searches, build strong talent pipelines, conduct candidate interviews, and partner with hiring teams to deliver exceptional hiring outcomes for clients worldwide.

Responsibilities

Candidate Sourcing

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, and internal databases.
  • Build and maintain pipelines of active and passive talent.
  • Develop sourcing strategies for a variety of roles.
  • Continuously identify new talent pools and sourcing channels.

Candidate Screening

  • Conduct recruiter phone and video interviews.
  • Evaluate candidates based on communication, technical skills, experience, and culture fit.
  • Prepare interview summaries and candidate evaluations.
  • Ensure candidates are ready for client interviews.

Recruitment Process Management

  • Manage multiple open roles simultaneously.
  • Coordinate candidates throughout the hiring process.
  • Maintain accurate ATS records and pipeline updates.
  • Ensure searches move efficiently while maintaining quality.

Client & Team Collaboration

  • Partner with Account Managers and internal teams on hiring priorities.
  • Present qualified candidates with resumes, interview notes, salary expectations, and video recordings.
  • Adjust sourcing strategies based on client feedback.
  • Support urgent hiring requests across multiple industries.

Candidate Experience

  • Maintain consistent communication throughout the hiring process.
  • Keep candidates informed of interview progress and next steps.
  • Build strong relationships with candidates.
  • Deliver a professional and responsive recruitment experience.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience.
  • Experience in agency, staffing, or offshore recruitment.
  • Experience recruiting for Sales, Executive Assistant, Customer Support, Marketing, Operations, and Technical roles.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation abilities.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, job boards, and sourcing tools.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple searches in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting international remote talent.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based clients.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, Slack, or recruiting CRM platforms.
  • Background in staffing, BPO, or offshore recruitment.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality candidate shortlists delivered quickly.
  • Strong interview-to-hire conversion rates.
  • Organized ATS and recruitment pipelines.
  • Excellent candidate experience and engagement.
  • High hiring manager and client satisfaction.

Interview Process

  • Application Review
  • Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  • Internal Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please check both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

raw.description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Join us on the

Product Management team as a Product Manager –Mobile Platform, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.

Start your journey with Anova today!

Role Summary

This role's center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You'll grow into deeper ownership as you build your track record here.

The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery across a defined product area within the Anova Unify platform. Working closely with a Senior PM or Director, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands-on execution role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won't be handed a roadmap to execute — you'll help shape it.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis. Build conviction before building product.
  • Own your backlog end-to-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from. Prioritize ruthlessly. Keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity.
  • Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release. Monitor adoption post-launch. Share what you're learning with the broader team and make fast, evidence-based adjustments.
  • Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner. Unblock your team. Make trade-off calls with good judgment and know when to escalate.
  • Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
  • Enable go-to-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you've shipped and why it matters.
  • Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area. Maintain a feedback loop with support and customer success to surface patterns early.

Outcomes you'll own

  • Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your deep curiosity about customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to value for our customers' customers.
  • Feature adoption and customer value realization. Features you ship get used, and customers can point to the value. You define the adoption metric before you ship, track it after, and iterate until it moves.
  • Discovery pipeline. A healthy, evidence-backed backlog — prioritized from real customer insight, validated with data, and ready for engineering.
  • On-time, high-quality delivery. Your area ships on cadence and predictably. Specs are clear, edge cases are handled, and engineering isn't blocked waiting for answers.
  • Squad metrics. You track velocity, cycle time, and escaped defects — not to report up, but to spot friction early and remove it.
  • NPS contribution. Customers in your product area trust the product and feel heard. You stay close to feedback, close the loop on issues, and bring the voice of the customer into every decision.

How you'll work at Anova

  • Specs, one-pagers, and decision memos are how we align a global, distributed team — writing clearly forces clear thinking. AI can help you draft, but writing well remains your skill to own.
  • You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and you bring a clear point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products.
  • You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature, and you're comfortable pulling the numbers yourself in a modern BI tool.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum Requirements -

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product area strategy and adoption outcomes.
  • 6+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, or related technical functions.
  • You have at least one example of taking a product, feature, or initiative from zero — no spec, no playbook — to something real and used.
  • Track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software in close partnership with engineering teams — from spec to production — using Agile/DevOps.
  • Experience conducting customer discovery interviews and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into prioritized, well-scoped backlog items.
  • Demonstrated use of AI and LLM tools in a PM context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight.
  • Ability to write clear, structured specs, one-pagers, and narratives for cross-functional audiences.
  • Comfort reasoning about technical trade-offs — APIs, data models, integration patterns — credibly with engineers.
  • Data fluency: define metrics, pull and analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence-based roadmap calls.

Preferred Qualifications -

  • Prior experience in IIoT, connected-hardware, SaaS, or industrial technology environments.
  • Experience shipping ML- or AI-assisted features in a SaaS product.
  • Exposure to industrial or field-operations workflows — understanding how things work in the physical world.
  • Background in venture or private-equity-backed high-growth industrial technology companies.

ABOUT ANOVA

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.
